samples.source: 启用流式合成之后，首段可播延迟降到 800 毫秒以内。
samples.reference: With streaming synthesis enabled, the time to first playable audio drops below 800 milliseconds.
samples.hypothesis: After enabling stream synthesis, the initial playback delay is reduced to under 800 milliseconds.

samples.source: VAD 模型把这段录音切成了三个语音段，静音部分被丢弃。
samples.reference: The VAD model split this recording into three speech segments and dropped the silent parts.
samples.hypothesis: The VAD model segmented this recording into three audio segments, with silent parts discarded.

samples.source: Kokoro v1.1 用 int8 量化后模型体积约 320 MB，中文自然度接近可用。
samples.reference: After int8 quantization, Kokoro v1.1 ships at roughly 320 MB and Mandarin naturalness is close to usable.
samples.hypothesis: Kokoro v1.1, after quantization using int8, has a model size of approximately 320 MB with natural Chinese fluency approaching usable levels.

samples.source: SenseVoice 的自动语言检测在粤夹普的语料上表现不太稳定。
samples.reference: SenseVoice's automatic language detection is not very stable on Cantonese-Mandarin code-switched speech.
samples.hypothesis: SenseVoice's automatic language detection is not very stable on Cantonese-Jiahu dialect corpora.

samples.source: 实时档走 argos，端到端延迟约 200 毫秒，够做面对面场景。
samples.reference: The realtime mode runs through argos with end-to-end latency around 200 ms, fast enough for face-to-face scenarios.
samples.hypothesis: Real-time mode uses Argos, with end-to-end latency of about 200 milliseconds, sufficient for face-to-face scenarios.

samples.source: 精译档走 madlad 加 ollama，质量优先，不承诺延迟预算。
samples.reference: The quality mode chains madlad and ollama and prioritizes accuracy over a latency budget.
samples.hypothesis: The refined document will be processed using madlad and ollama, with quality being the priority. No delays or budget commitments are guaranteed.

samples.source: 隐私模式是硬不变量，任何配置都无法把云端引擎纳入路由。
samples.reference: Privacy mode is a hard invariant: no configuration can route cloud engines into the pipeline.
samples.hypothesis: Privacy mode is a hard constant; no configuration can include the cloud engine in the routing.

samples.source: 翻译记忆命中率超过三成时，成本几乎只剩模型侧的一次性开销。
samples.reference: Once the translation memory hit rate passes thirty percent, cost is essentially a one-time model expense.
samples.hypothesis: When the translation memory hit rate exceeds 30%, the cost is almost reduced to just one-time model-side expenses.

samples.source: 缓冲区太小会造成卡顿；太大会推高端到端延迟。
samples.reference: A buffer that is too small causes stuttering; one that is too large inflates end-to-end latency.
samples.hypothesis: A buffer that is too small will cause lag; one that is too large will introduce end-to-end latency.

samples.source: 音频的采样率与位深决定了原始波形的数据量。
samples.reference: The sample rate and bit depth of audio determine the volume of raw waveform data.
samples.hypothesis: The sampling rate and bit depth of the audio determine the amount of data for the original waveform.

samples.source: 单声道 16 千赫兹 16 位是语音识别最常见的输入格式。
samples.reference: Mono 16 kHz 16-bit is the most common input format for automatic speech recognition.
samples.hypothesis: Mono 16 kHz 16-bit is the most common input format for speech recognition.

samples.source: 双声道立体声在配音场景里通常会被下混回单声道再送入 ASR。
samples.reference: Stereo dual-channel audio is usually down-mixed to mono before being fed to the ASR model in a dubbing workflow.
samples.hypothesis: In dubbing scenes, stereo audio is usually mixed back to mono before being fed into the ASR.

samples.source: 帧长 25 毫秒、帧移 10 毫秒是声学特征提取的常规配置。
samples.reference: A frame size of 25 ms and a frame shift of 10 ms is the standard setup for acoustic feature extraction.
samples.hypothesis: Frame length of 25 milliseconds and frame shift of 10 milliseconds are standard configurations for acoustic feature extraction.

samples.source: 梅尔频谱图是把波形转换成模型可读输入的关键中间表示。
samples.reference: The mel spectrogram is the key intermediate representation that turns a waveform into something the model can read.
samples.hypothesis: The Mel Spectrogram is a key intermediate representation that converts waveforms into a model-readable format.

samples.source: 强制对齐可以把参考文本与识别输出逐字对齐，用于时间戳生成。
samples.reference: Forced alignment lines up the reference text and the recognition output word by word, used to generate timestamps.
samples.hypothesis: Forced alignment can align the reference text with the recognized output character by character, used for timestamp generation.

samples.source: 逆文本规整把 "二零二六年" 转成 "2026 年"，让下游解析更简单。
samples.reference: Inverse text normalization converts "two thousand twenty-six" into "2026" so downstream parsing is simpler.
samples.hypothesis: 2026 year

samples.source: 中英混排句子里，专用术语最好走术语表而不是让模型自由发挥。
samples.reference: In code-switched sentences, domain terminology should be pulled from the glossary rather than left to the model's imagination.
samples.hypothesis: In mixed Chinese-English sentences, it is best to use the terminology dictionary for specialized terms rather than letting the model improvise.

samples.source: Ollama 的提示注入要显式禁用思考模式，不然首字延迟会翻倍。
samples.reference: Prompt injection into Ollama must explicitly disable thinking mode, otherwise the time to first token doubles.
samples.hypothesis: For Ollama's prompt injection, you must explicitly disable the thinking mode; otherwise, the initial character delay will double.

samples.source: CUDA 提供程序在这块 RTX 4050 上给 TTS 带来的加速约 3 倍。
samples.reference: The CUDA provider gives TTS roughly a three-times speedup on this RTX 4050.
samples.hypothesis: The CUDA driver provides about 3x acceleration for TTS on this RTX 4050.

samples.source: CPU 上跑 3B int8 模型的现实是每句 2 到 4 秒，不适合实时场景。
samples.reference: Running a 3B int8 model on CPU is realistically 2 to 4 seconds per sentence, not fit for realtime scenarios.
samples.hypothesis: The reality of running a 3B int8 model on a CPU is that it takes 2 to 4 seconds per sentence, making it unsuitable for real-time scenarios.

samples.source: 字幕轨导出成 SRT 之后可以直接被播放器读取，不需要重新编码视频。
samples.reference: The subtitle track exported as SRT can be read directly by players without re-encoding the video.
samples.hypothesis: After exporting the subtitle track as an SRT file, it can be directly read by the player without needing to re-encode the video.

samples.source: 双语字幕要求时序对齐：中文行与英文行必须落在同一时间窗口内。
samples.reference: Bilingual subtitles require timing alignment: the Chinese and English lines must share the same time window.
samples.hypothesis: Bilingual subtitles must have temporal alignment: Chinese lines and English lines must fall within the same time window.

samples.source: 硬字幕是烧进画面的，之后想改只能重编码；软字幕可以随时替换。
samples.reference: Burned-in subtitles are part of the picture, so editing them later requires re-encoding; soft subtitles can be swapped at any time.
samples.hypothesis: Hard subtitles are burned into the image, so any changes afterward require re-encoding; soft subtitles can be replaced at any time.

samples.source: 配音与对口型是两回事：前者关注语音替换，后者关注画面同步。
samples.reference: Dubbing and lip sync are separate concerns: the first replaces the audio, the second keeps the picture in sync.
samples.hypothesis: Voice dubbing and lip-syncing are two different things: the former focuses on voice replacement, while the latter focuses on visual synchronization.

samples.source: 声画同步误差控制在 40 毫秒以内，人眼才不会觉得违和。
samples.reference: Audio-video sync error within 40 milliseconds is imperceptible to human viewers.
samples.hypothesis: The audio-visual synchronization error must be controlled within 40 milliseconds to avoid a noticeable discrepancy to the human eye.

samples.source: 量化参数越高压缩率越高但画质损失越明显，需要在两者之间取舍。
samples.reference: A higher quantization parameter means a smaller bitrate but worse quality; the trade-off has to be tuned.
samples.hypothesis: The higher the quantization parameters, the greater the compression rate, but the more significant the quality loss, requiring a trade-off between the two.

samples.source: GOP 越长比特率越低但快进快退越迟钝，直播场景一般不超过 2 秒。
samples.reference: A longer GOP lowers bitrate but makes seek response sluggish; live streaming usually caps it at two seconds.
samples.hypothesis: The longer the GOP, the lower the bit rate, but the faster the playback and rewinding becomes slower. In live streaming scenarios, this typically doesn't exceed 2 seconds.

samples.source: 词错误率与字符错误率不能相互替代，中文更常用字符错误率。
samples.reference: Word error rate and character error rate are not interchangeable; Chinese benchmarks typically report character error rate.
samples.hypothesis: Word error rate and character error rate are not interchangeable; Chinese more commonly uses character error rate.

samples.source: FLORES-101 是通用域，与产品主打的涉密文档与批量本地化场景仍有分布差。
samples.reference: FLORES-101 is general domain, still a distributional mismatch with the confidential-document and batch-localization scenarios this product targets.
samples.hypothesis: FLORES-101 is a general-purpose domain, which still has a distribution gap compared to the main products focused on classified documents and batch localization scenarios.

samples.source: 术语表按语言对检索，同名条目在通用与领域之间会冲突，需要 domain 段来分组。
samples.reference: The glossary is looked up by language pair; entries with the same source term collide between generic and domain rows, so the primary key needs a domain segment.
samples.hypothesis: The terminology should be searched by language pair. Entries with the same name may conflict between general and domain-specific contexts, requiring grouping within the domain section.

samples.source: 语音活动检测的阈值调低会把呼吸声也切成语音段，调高则会吞掉句末弱读。
samples.reference: Lowering the voice activity detection threshold cuts breathing into speech segments as well; raising it swallows weak syllables at sentence ends.
samples.hypothesis: Lowering the threshold for voice activity detection will also segment breathing sounds as voice segments, while raising it will swallow the weak pronunciation at the end of a sentence.

samples.source: 自动语音识别的后处理通常包含标点恢复与数字规整两个独立步骤。
samples.reference: Post-processing for automatic speech recognition usually involves two independent steps: punctuation restoration and number normalization.
samples.hypothesis: Post-processing for automatic speech recognition typically includes two separate steps: punctuation restoration and number normalization.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译的编码器把源句压成上下文向量，解码器再自回归生成目标句。
samples.reference: In neural machine translation the encoder squeezes the source sentence into a context vector and the decoder autoregressively generates the target sentence.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder of neural machine translation compresses the source sentence into a context vector, and the decoder then generates the target sentence autoregressively.

samples.source: 文本转语音的前端要做分词、字音转换和韵律预测三级流水，任一级掉链子都会破坏自然度。
samples.reference: The text-to-speech frontend runs three stages -- tokenization, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion and prosody prediction -- and a failure in any of them hurts naturalness.
samples.hypothesis: The front-end for text-to-speech requires a three-stage pipeline: segmentation, phonetic conversion, and rhythm prediction. If any single stage fails, it will compromise the naturalness of the output.

samples.source: 流式识别与离线识别的差别不只是延迟，还包括前缀假设与最终结果的一致性。
samples.reference: Streaming recognition differs from offline recognition not only in latency but also in the consistency between prefix hypotheses and the final result.
samples.hypothesis: The difference between streaming recognition and offline recognition goes beyond just latency; it also involves prefix assumptions and consistency of the final results.

samples.source: 同声传译产品化时最常见的取舍是 "延迟换准确率"，滑窗大小直接决定这两者。
samples.reference: The most common trade-off when productizing real-time interpretation is "buying accuracy with latency", and the sliding-window size directly determines both.
samples.hypothesis: When productizing simultaneous interpretation, the most common trade-off is "delay versus accuracy," and the window size directly determines these two factors.

samples.source: 批量本地化管线要能在 1000 句的规模下保持每小时不崩，因此断点续传与幂等重跑是硬要求。
samples.reference: A batch localization pipeline must survive a thousand-sentence run for hours without crashing, which makes checkpoint-resume and idempotent retries hard requirements.
samples.hypothesis: The batch localization pipeline must be able to handle 1000 sentences per hour without crashing, making checkpointing and idempotent retractions essential requirements.

samples.source: 语音翻译与文本翻译共用同一套路由：TM 命中、隐私钳制、语言对分档、置信度门控、AI 升级。
samples.reference: Speech translation and text translation share the same routing: TM hit, privacy clamp, per-language-pair tiering, confidence gating and AI upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: Voice translation and text translation share the same routing system: TM hit, privacy restriction, language pair segmentation, confidence gating, and AI upgrade.

samples.source: 端点检测比 VAD 更严格，它需要区分 "句子说完" 与 "句中停顿"。
samples.reference: Endpoint detection is stricter than VAD -- it has to distinguish "sentence finished" from "pause inside a sentence".
samples.hypothesis: Endpoint detection is stricter than VAD; it needs to distinguish between "the sentence is finished" and "a pause within the sentence."

samples.source: 说话人分离在会议录音上表现好，在重叠说话的播客里就明显退化。
samples.reference: Speaker diarization works well on meeting recordings but degrades visibly on podcasts with overlapping speech.
samples.hypothesis: The speaker separation performed well in the meeting recording, but it clearly deteriorated in the podcast with overlapping speech.

samples.source: 情感语音合成需要额外一路韵律条件，不能只靠文本前端。
samples.reference: Expressive speech synthesis needs an extra prosody conditioning channel and cannot rely on the text frontend alone.
samples.hypothesis: Emotional voice synthesis requires additional rhythmic conditions; it cannot rely solely on the front-end text.

samples.source: 零样本音色克隆只要 5 秒参考音频就能起步，但对采样率与信噪比敏感。
samples.reference: Zero-shot speaker cloning can start from just five seconds of reference audio but is sensitive to sample rate and signal-to-noise ratio.
samples.hypothesis: Zero-sample voice tone cloning can start with just 5 seconds of reference audio, but it is sensitive to sample rate and signal-to-noise ratio.

samples.source: 语音识别的置信度分数不能直接搬到翻译置信度上，两者校准曲线完全不同。
samples.reference: A speech recognition confidence score cannot be lifted directly into a translation confidence score; their calibration curves are entirely different.
samples.hypothesis: The confidence score for voice recognition cannot be directly applied to translation confidence scores, as their calibration curves are completely different.

samples.source: Kokoro 的中文男声 sid 45-52 中，52 混排表现最好，48 更贴近播音腔。
samples.reference: Among Kokoro's Mandarin voices at sid 45-52, 52 handles CJK/Latin code-switching best while 48 sits closer to a broadcast tone.
samples.hypothesis: Among Kokoro's male voice samples, 52 has the best mixed arrangement, while 48 is closer to a broadcast voice.

samples.source: Whisper 类模型在长语音上会漂移，切片策略一般按 VAD 边界而不是固定 30 秒。
samples.reference: Whisper-style models drift on long audio, so the standard slicing policy follows VAD boundaries rather than a fixed 30 seconds.
samples.hypothesis: Whisper models tend to drift for long audio clips, and the segmentation strategy typically follows VAD boundaries rather than a fixed 30-second window.

samples.source: 流式 ASR 的因果性约束意味着当前的识别不能引用未来帧，与离线模型有本质差别。
samples.reference: The causality constraint in streaming ASR means the current hypothesis cannot look ahead to future frames -- a fundamental difference from offline models.
samples.hypothesis: The causal constraint of streaming ASR means that the current recognition cannot reference future frames, which is fundamentally different from offline models.

samples.source: 实时字幕的常见做法是稳定前缀 + 浮动后缀，让阅读体验不至于一句话改三遍。
samples.reference: Real-time subtitles usually stabilize the prefix and let the suffix float, so a single sentence is not rewritten three times for the reader.
samples.hypothesis: Common practices for real-time subtitles include a stable prefix and a floating suffix to ensure the reading experience doesn't require changing a sentence three times.

samples.source: 批量本地化任务往往跨夜跑，日志聚合与断言式失败必须能事后重放。
samples.reference: Batch localization jobs often run overnight, so log aggregation and assertion-style failures must be replayable after the fact.
samples.hypothesis: Batch localization tasks often span overnight, so log aggregation and assertive failures must be replayable post-factum.

samples.source: 端到端语音翻译把 ASR、MT、TTS 融成一个模型，牺牲可解释性换更低延迟。
samples.reference: End-to-end speech translation collapses ASR, MT and TTS into a single model, trading interpretability for lower latency.
samples.hypothesis: End-to-end voice translation integrates ASR, MT, and TTS into a single model, sacrificing interpretability for lower latency.

samples.source: 语音采样率与位深决定了奈奎斯特频率上限，16 千赫兹的语音只能表达 8 千赫兹以下的成分。
samples.reference: The audio sample rate and bit depth set the Nyquist ceiling; 16 kHz speech can only carry content below 8 kHz.
samples.hypothesis: The sampling rate and bit depth determine the upper limit of the Nyquist frequency; a 16 kHz voice can only express components below 8 kHz.

samples.source: 声码器负责把频谱反演回波形，Griffin-Lim 慢而糊，神经网络声码器快且清晰。
samples.reference: A vocoder inverts the spectrum back into a waveform -- Griffin-Lim is slow and muddy, while neural vocoders are fast and clean.
samples.hypothesis: The vocoder is responsible for converting the spectrum back into waveforms. The Griffin-Lim method is slow and blurry, while the neural network vocoder is fast and clear.

samples.source: 基频 F0 的估计常用自相关或 YIN 算法，浊音段准，清音段本身就是噪声。
samples.reference: Fundamental-frequency estimation usually uses autocorrelation or YIN; both are accurate on voiced segments, but unvoiced segments are noise by definition.
samples.hypothesis: The fundamental frequency F0 is commonly estimated using autocorrelation or the YIN algorithm. The voiced segments are accurate, while the unvoiced segments are inherently noise.

samples.source: 倒谱系数取前 40 维已经足够覆盖大部分人耳可辨的频谱特征。
samples.reference: The first 40 cepstral coefficients already cover most of the spectral detail the human ear can distinguish.
samples.hypothesis: Taking the first 40 dimensions of the inverse spectral coefficients is sufficient to cover the perceptible spectral features for most people.

samples.source: 立体声到单声道 down-mix 需要按能量归一而不是简单平均，不然左右声道的相位差会引入染色。
samples.reference: Down-mixing stereo to mono should normalize by energy rather than average samples, otherwise the phase difference between channels colors the output.
samples.hypothesis: Down-mixing from stereo to mono requires energy normalization rather than simple averaging, otherwise the phase difference between the left and right channels will introduce coloration.

samples.source: 静音压缩通过保留 VAD 判定的语音段来实现，会议录音可以省下 30% 到 50% 时长。
samples.reference: Silence compression keeps only the segments VAD flags as speech, saving 30 to 50 percent of the length on typical meeting recordings.
samples.hypothesis: Silent compression is achieved by retaining the audio segments identified by the VAD, which can save 30% to 50% of the meeting recording duration.

samples.source: 重采样从 48 千赫兹降到 16 千赫兹要先做抗混叠低通滤波，不然高频会折叠进语音带。
samples.reference: Resampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz must apply an anti-aliasing low-pass filter first, otherwise high frequencies fold into the speech band.
samples.hypothesis: To downsample from 48 kHz to 16 kHz, you must first apply an anti-aliasing low-pass filter, otherwise high-frequency components will fold into the speech band.

samples.source: 信噪比低于 10 分贝的现场录音通常要先做降噪再送 ASR。
samples.reference: Field recordings with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 dB usually need denoising before being sent to ASR.
samples.hypothesis: Field recordings with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 decibels typically require noise reduction before being sent to the ASR.

samples.source: 预加重滤波把高频抬起来，能让后续特征提取对小擦音更敏感。
samples.reference: Pre-emphasis filtering lifts high frequencies so that later feature extraction is more sensitive to weak fricatives.
samples.hypothesis: Pre-emphasis filtering boosts high frequencies, making subsequent feature extraction more sensitive to small articulations.

samples.source: 分帧时常用的汉明窗能显著削弱矩形窗带来的吉布斯振铃。
samples.reference: A Hamming window is standard during framing and noticeably reduces the Gibbs ringing a rectangular window would introduce.
samples.hypothesis: The Hamming window, commonly used for frame division, can significantly reduce the Gibbs ringing caused by the rectangular window.

samples.source: 帧率 25 fps 是影视的常规，50 fps 会让观众觉得 "太像新闻"。
samples.reference: A 25 fps frame rate is normal for film; 50 fps makes viewers feel it "looks too much like news footage".
samples.hypothesis: Frame rate of 25 fps is standard for film and television, while 50 fps makes the audience feel it "looks too much like news."

samples.source: 位深度从 16 升到 24 位不会让响度更大，但动态范围与量化噪声显著改善。
samples.reference: Raising bit depth from 16 to 24 does not increase loudness but improves dynamic range and quantization noise noticeably.
samples.hypothesis: An increasing bit depth from 16 to 24 bits does not increase loudness, but it significantly improves dynamic range and quantization noise.

samples.source: 音画同步在编码链路上要留一个音视频缓冲差，视频通常比音频晚 20 毫秒。
samples.reference: Audio-video sync has to leave a small buffer skew in the encoding chain -- video is typically about 20 ms behind audio.
samples.hypothesis: Audio-visual synchronization should account for an audio-video buffer lag in the encoding pipeline, with video typically lagging behind audio by 20 milliseconds.

samples.source: 声道布局从 5.1 下混到立体声要用 Dolby Pro Logic 而不是简单相加。
samples.reference: Down-mixing from 5.1 to stereo should use Dolby Pro Logic rather than a straight sum.
samples.hypothesis: For the channel layout transition from 5.1 down to stereo, use Dolby Pro Logic instead of simple addition.

samples.source: 频谱质心、零过率、能量这三个特征就能把音乐与语音分开。
samples.reference: Spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate and energy are enough to separate music from speech.
samples.hypothesis: The three features of spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate, and energy can distinguish music from speech.

samples.source: 梅尔刻度是仿人耳感知非线性；线性刻度做 FFT 直接分箱不符合听觉心理。
samples.reference: The mel scale mirrors the non-linear frequency perception of human hearing; a linear FFT binning does not match psychoacoustics.
samples.hypothesis: The Mel scale is a non-linear model of human auditory perception; using a linear scale for FFT and direct binning does not align with auditory psychology.

samples.source: 基音周期与共振峰是语音产生物理模型里最基础的两个概念。
samples.reference: Pitch period and formants are the two most basic concepts in the physical model of speech production.
samples.hypothesis: Fundamental frequency period and resonance peak are the two most basic concepts in the physical model of voice production.

samples.source: 声纹识别与说话人分离是两回事：前者固定身份集合做识别，后者只做聚类不分身份。
samples.reference: Voiceprint recognition and speaker diarization are not the same: the first identifies a fixed set of speakers, the second only clusters without identities.
samples.hypothesis: Voice signature recognition and separating the speaker are two different things: the former uses a fixed set of identities for recognition, while the latter only performs clustering without identifying the speaker.

samples.source: 音频缓冲不足会引发 dropout，视频缓冲不足会引发跳帧，两者表现不同但根因都是背压。
samples.reference: Insufficient audio buffering causes dropouts, insufficient video buffering causes frame skips -- different symptoms but the same root cause is backpressure.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient audio buffering causes dropouts, while insufficient video buffering causes frame drops. Although their manifestations differ, the root cause is both back pressure.

samples.source: 流式协议里 chunk 与 packet 常被混用，但对时延统计而言是两个概念。
samples.reference: In streaming protocols chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but for latency accounting they are two different concepts.
samples.hypothesis: In streaming protocols, "chunk" and "packet" are often used interchangeably, but they are two distinct concepts when it comes to latency measurement.

samples.source: 抖动缓冲动态调整目标延迟，网络好时压到 20 毫秒，网络差时拉到 200 毫秒。
samples.reference: A jitter buffer dynamically retargets delay -- pushing it down to 20 ms when the network is good and stretching it to 200 ms when the network is bad.
samples.hypothesis: Dynamic target latency adjustment for jitter buffering: it is reduced to 20 milliseconds when the network is good, and increased to 200 milliseconds when the network is poor.

samples.source: 流水线里任何一级的吞吐瓶颈都会把上游顶爆，反压信号必须能一路传回输入端。
samples.reference: Any throughput bottleneck in a pipeline will back up everything upstream, so the backpressure signal has to propagate all the way to the input.
samples.hypothesis: Any bottleneck at any level in the assembly line will cause the upstream to be overwhelmed; the feedback signal must be able to travel all the way back to the input.

samples.source: TCP 的重传会破坏实时性，音视频低延迟场景普遍走 UDP 加前向纠错。
samples.reference: TCP retransmission ruins real-time behaviour; low-latency audio and video usually ride on UDP with forward error correction.
samples.hypothesis: TCP retransmission can disrupt real-time performance, so low-latency audio and video scenarios typically use UDP combined with forward error correction.

samples.source: 关键帧间隔太长会让 seek 卡顿，太短会让相同画质下比特率翻倍。
samples.reference: Keyframes spaced too far apart make seeking stutter; too close and the bitrate doubles for the same quality.
samples.hypothesis: Too long keyframe intervals cause seek lag, while too short intervals double the bitrate at the same image quality.

samples.source: 分块处理时相邻块要有 50% 重叠，不然边界处的能量估计会跳变。
samples.reference: Chunked processing needs 50 percent overlap between adjacent chunks, otherwise the energy estimate jumps at the boundaries.
samples.hypothesis: When processing in blocks, adjacent blocks must have a 50% overlap; otherwise, the energy estimation at the boundaries will jump.

samples.source: 冲刷操作的语义是 "把当前缓冲里的内容全部吐出去并结束本段"。
samples.reference: Flush means "emit everything currently in the buffer and terminate this segment".
samples.hypothesis: The meaning of the flush operation is "to completely output the content in the current buffer and end this segment."

samples.source: 端到端流水线里背压没设计好时，最下游的消费者慢就整条链堵死。
samples.reference: If backpressure is not designed in an end-to-end pipeline, a slow consumer at the tail stalls the entire chain.
samples.hypothesis: When the backpressure in the end-to-end pipeline is not properly designed, the slowest consumer at the downstream end will block the entire chain.

samples.source: 缓冲预取一般按帧数而不是按时长，因为帧才是模型的原子单位。
samples.reference: Buffer prefetch usually counts in frames, not in seconds, because a frame is the atomic unit of the model.
samples.hypothesis: Buffer prefetching is generally based on frame rate rather than duration, because frames are the atomic units of the model.

samples.source: 流式合成的边界要落在词或短语之后，切在助词或连词中间会明显刺耳。
samples.reference: Streaming synthesis boundaries should land after a word or phrase; cutting at a particle or conjunction is audibly jarring.
samples.hypothesis: The boundaries of stream synthesis should fall after words or phrases; cutting them in the middle of particles or conjunctions will sound noticeably harsh.

samples.source: 数据报传输协议丢一两个包时解码器要能优雅丢帧而不是崩。
samples.reference: When the datagram transport protocol drops one or two packets, the decoder should gracefully conceal rather than crash.
samples.hypothesis: When one or two packets are lost in the datagram transmission protocol, the decoder should gracefully drop frames instead of crashing.

samples.source: 恒定比特率适合广播，可变比特率适合存储；两者的缓冲模型完全不同。
samples.reference: Constant bitrate suits broadcast, variable bitrate suits storage -- their buffering models are completely different.
samples.hypothesis: Constant bit rate is suitable for broadcasting, while variable bit rate is suitable for storage; their buffering models are completely different.

samples.source: 容器只负责封装与同步，编解码器负责压缩；把 mkv 转成 mp4 不需要重编码。
samples.reference: The container only handles packaging and synchronisation; the codec handles compression. Turning an mkv into an mp4 needs no re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: Containers are only responsible for encapsulation and synchronization, while encoders and decoders handle compression. Converting MKV to MP4 does not require re-encoding.

samples.source: 比特流的网络抽象层携带时序与合成信息，缺失会让解码器无法正确解码。
samples.reference: The network abstraction layer of the bitstream carries timing and composition information; missing it leaves the decoder unable to render correctly.
samples.hypothesis: The network abstraction layer of Bitstream carries timing and synthesis information; its absence will prevent the decoder from decoding correctly.

samples.source: 编码器要显式声明 profile 与 level，播放器据此判断能不能吃下这条流。
samples.reference: The encoder must declare its profile and level explicitly so the player can decide whether it can accept this stream.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder must explicitly declare the profile and level, which the player uses to determine if it can handle the stream.

samples.source: 解复用就是把一个容器拆开成若干条音视频字幕轨，不做任何解码。
samples.reference: Demultiplexing means splitting a container into its video, audio and subtitle tracks without decoding anything.
samples.hypothesis: Demultiplexing involves splitting a container into multiple audio and video subtitle tracks without any decoding.

samples.source: 无损压缩对波形做熵编码，可以逐比特还原；有损压缩引入量化误差。
samples.reference: Lossless compression entropy-codes the waveform and can restore it bit-for-bit; lossy compression introduces quantization error.
samples.hypothesis: Lossless compression uses entropy coding on the waveform, allowing for bit-by-bit reconstruction; lossy compression introduces quantization error.

samples.source: 转码时如果源和目标编解码器不同，一定要经过帧缓冲重排。
samples.reference: Transcoding between different source and target codecs must go through a frame buffer for reorder.
samples.hypothesis: When the source and destination encoders are different during transcoding, frame buffering and reordering are required.

samples.source: 帧内预测只依赖当前帧，帧间预测要引用参考帧，二者的错误传播特性不同。
samples.reference: Intra-frame prediction depends only on the current frame; inter-frame prediction references other frames, and the two propagate errors differently.
samples.hypothesis: Intra-frame prediction only depends on the current frame, while inter-frame prediction requires referencing a reference frame. The error propagation characteristics of the two are different.

samples.source: 运动估计的搜索半径越大越精确但也越慢，默认 16 像素是常见折中。
samples.reference: A larger motion-estimation search radius is more accurate but slower; 16 pixels is the common default.
samples.hypothesis: The larger the search radius for motion estimation, the more precise it is, but also the slower it becomes. A default of 16 pixels is a common compromise.

samples.source: 熵编码用霍夫曼或算术编码；算术编码效率略高但专利与复杂度都是负担。
samples.reference: Entropy coding uses Huffman or arithmetic coding -- the latter is slightly more efficient but carries patent and complexity overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Entropy encoding uses Huffman coding or arithmetic coding; arithmetic coding offers slightly higher efficiency, but its patent protection and complexity are drawbacks.

samples.source: 码率控制要感知内容，静态场景压低码率，运动场景放开码率。
samples.reference: Rate control should be content-aware: lower bitrate for static scenes, higher bitrate for motion-heavy scenes.
samples.hypothesis: Bitrate control needs to perceive the content; reduce the bitrate in static scenes and increase it in motion scenes.

samples.source: AVC、HEVC、VVC 每一代同画质下比特率大致降一半，复杂度大约翻倍。
samples.reference: Each generation from AVC to HEVC to VVC roughly halves the bitrate for the same quality but doubles the complexity.
samples.hypothesis: For each generation of AVC, HEVC, and VVC, at the same quality level, the bitrate is roughly halved while the complexity doubles.

samples.source: Opus 在 6 到 512 千比特率之间自适应，是互联网语音的默认选择。
samples.reference: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbps and is the default choice for voice on the internet.
samples.hypothesis: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbps and is the default choice for internet voice calls.

samples.source: FLAC 无损压缩率大约 5:1，适合母带归档；MP3 是有损，别用来做二压。
samples.reference: FLAC compresses losslessly around 5:1 and is suited to archiving masters; MP3 is lossy and should never be secondarily compressed.
samples.hypothesis: FLAC has a lossless compression ratio of about 5:1, suitable for master archive. MP3 is lossy, so don't use it for re-compression.

samples.source: 视频字幕要处理换行宽度、字符编码与字体缺字三个独立问题。
samples.reference: Video subtitles have to handle three independent problems: line-width wrapping, character encoding and missing glyphs.
samples.hypothesis: The video subtitles need to handle three separate issues: line break width, character encoding, and missing characters in the font.

samples.source: SubRip 只有时间轴与文本两栏，样式能力弱；ASS 有事件与样式两栏，能表达卡拉OK。
samples.reference: SubRip only has timing and text fields, weak styling; ASS adds event and style sections and can express karaoke effects.
samples.hypothesis: SubRip has only time axis and text columns, with limited styling capabilities; ASS has event and style columns, suitable for karaoke.

samples.source: WebVTT 是 W3C 定义的网页字幕格式，天然与 HTML5 播放器对接。
samples.reference: WebVTT is the W3C-defined subtitle format for the web and slots straight into HTML5 players.
samples.hypothesis: WebVTT is a web subtitle format defined by the W3C, naturally compatible with HTML5 players.

samples.source: 逐字时间戳需要强制对齐输出，纯 ASR 只有段级时间戳。
samples.reference: Word-level timestamps require forced-alignment output; ASR alone only provides segment-level timing.
samples.hypothesis: The character-by-character timestamp must be strictly aligned. Pure ASR only provides segment-level timestamps.

samples.source: 字幕断行要按语义而不是按字符数：把 "声画同步" 拆到两行会破坏阅读。
samples.reference: Subtitle line breaks should follow meaning rather than character count; splitting "audio-video sync" across two lines wrecks readability.
samples.hypothesis: Audio-visual synchronization should be broken across lines based on meaning, not character count. Breaking "声画同步" into two lines would disrupt readability.

samples.source: 硬字幕化流程 = 抽帧、烧字、重编码；每一步都可能引入代际损失。
samples.reference: Burning in subtitles means extracting frames, drawing captions and re-encoding -- each step can add a generation of loss.
samples.hypothesis: Hard subtitling process = frame extraction, text burning, re-encoding; each step can introduce intergenerational loss.

samples.source: 对口型算法在真人上主要看嘴部关键点，在动画上要看帧与语音能量包络。
samples.reference: Lip-sync algorithms track mouth keypoints on real people and match frame-by-frame energy envelopes on animation.
samples.hypothesis: For lip-sync algorithms, the main focus is on the key points of the mouth in real people; for animation, it involves frames and the energy envelope of the voice.

samples.source: 配音时原声要压低 12 分贝做 ducking，不然观众听不清配音。
samples.reference: When dubbing, duck the original audio by 12 dB or viewers will miss the new voice.
samples.hypothesis: During dubbing, the original voice should be ducked by 12 decibels to ensure the audience can clearly hear the dubbed voice.

samples.source: 解说场景往往需要保留少量背景音，纯静音配音会让人出戏。
samples.reference: Voiceover scenes usually keep a little background ambience; pure silence makes the viewer drop out of the scene.
samples.hypothesis: When narrating a scene, it's often necessary to retain some background sounds; a completely silent voiceover would make it feel out of place.

samples.source: 多角色配音要按说话人分离结果分别合成，再按时间戳混流。
samples.reference: Multi-role dubbing must synthesise each speaker separately by diarization result, then remux by timestamp.
samples.hypothesis: Multiple character voiceovers must be synthesized separately according to the speaker separation results, then mixed together based on timestamps.

samples.source: 双语字幕对齐时如果两边段落数不同，宁可拆段也不要错开。
samples.reference: When bilingual subtitles have mismatched segment counts, split segments rather than let them drift out of phase.
samples.hypothesis: When aligning bilingual subtitles, if the number of paragraphs on either side is different, it's better to split the paragraph rather than misalign it.

samples.source: 时间轴漂移在长视频里会累积，每 10 分钟要人工核对一次锚点。
samples.reference: Timeline drift accumulates on long videos; check the anchors by hand every ten minutes.
samples.hypothesis: Time drift accumulates in long videos, so anchor points need to be manually checked every 10 minutes.

samples.source: 音轨抽取常用 ffmpeg 的 -vn 参数，代价是重封装而不是重编码。
samples.reference: Extracting an audio track usually uses ffmpeg's -vn flag; the cost is remuxing, not re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: The common ffmpeg parameter for audio track extraction is -vn, which involves re-packaging rather than re-encoding.

samples.source: 字幕嵌入视频流会让不支持字幕的播放器也能显示，代价是不可关闭。
samples.reference: Embedding subtitles into the video stream lets even non-subtitle players display them, at the cost of losing the on/off toggle.
samples.hypothesis: Embedding subtitles into a video stream allows players that don't support subtitles to display them, at the cost of being unable to disable them.

samples.source: 视频重封装时如果编码格式没变，可以逐包拷贝，秒级完成。
samples.reference: Remuxing a video where the codec has not changed can copy packet-by-packet and finish in seconds.
samples.hypothesis: If the encoding format remains unchanged during video re-packaging, you can copy each package sequentially, which can be completed in seconds.

samples.source: 帧精确的字幕对齐要求毫秒级时间戳，段级精度在快语速时不够用。
samples.reference: Frame-accurate subtitle alignment requires millisecond timestamps; segment-level accuracy is not enough for fast speech.
samples.hypothesis: Frame-level precise subtitle alignment requires millisecond-level timestamps; segment-level precision is insufficient at high speaking speeds.

samples.source: 时间码 SMPTE 12 小时制在 30 帧率下有掉帧与非掉帧两种，跨系统同步时要显式声明。
samples.reference: SMPTE 12-hour timecode has drop-frame and non-drop-frame variants at 30 fps; state which one when synchronising across systems.
samples.hypothesis: The SMPTE 12-hour timecode has two modes—frame drops and non-drop frames—at 30 fps. This must be explicitly declared during cross-system synchronization.

samples.source: 配音脚本的时长要与原视频对齐，写译文时要按 "口型开放度" 估算音节上限。
samples.reference: Dubbing scripts must match the duration of the original video; when writing translations, estimate the syllable budget from visible mouth openness.
samples.hypothesis: The duration of the voiceover script must align with the original video. When writing the translation, estimate the maximum number of syllables based on the "mouth opening degree".

samples.source: 模型检查点最好同时保存权重、优化器状态与 tokenizer，方便续训与推理。
samples.reference: A model checkpoint should store weights, optimiser state and the tokenizer together, so resuming training and inference are both easy.
samples.hypothesis: It's best to save the model checkpoint along with the weights, optimizer state, and tokenizer for easier resuming and inference.

samples.source: 子词切分把未登录词拆成可组合的部件，词表大小与切分粒度直接相关。
samples.reference: Subword tokenization breaks unknown words into combinable pieces; vocabulary size and merge granularity are directly related.
samples.hypothesis: Subword splitting breaks down an unlogged word into combinable components. The size of the vocabulary directly relates to the granularity of the splitting.

samples.source: 字节对编码从字符级开始反复合并高频对，构造出面向该语料的最优词表。
samples.reference: Byte-pair encoding starts from characters and repeatedly merges the most frequent pairs, producing a vocabulary optimised for that corpus.
samples.hypothesis: Byte-level encoding is iteratively combined from the character level to construct the optimal vocabulary for this corpus.

samples.source: 词嵌入把符号映射到连续空间，语义相近的词在向量空间里距离更近。
samples.reference: Word embeddings map symbols into continuous space so that semantically similar words lie close together in the vector space.
samples.hypothesis: Word embeddings map symbols to continuous spaces, so semantically similar words are closer in the vector space.

samples.source: 注意力机制允许解码器在每一步软选择性地查看源句的所有位置。
samples.reference: Attention allows the decoder at every step to softly inspect every position in the source sentence.
samples.hypothesis: The attention mechanism allows the decoder to selectively view all positions in the source sentence at each step.

samples.source: Transformer 用自注意力替代循环结构，训练时并行度高但推理时 KV 缓存吃内存。
samples.reference: The Transformer replaces recurrence with self-attention -- high parallelism during training, but KV-cache cost at inference time.
samples.hypothesis: Transformers replace recurrent structures with self-attention. Training involves high parallelism, but KV cache consumes a lot of memory during inference.

samples.source: 量化到 int8 后模型体积大约压到三分之一，速度提升视硬件与算子而定。
samples.reference: Quantising to int8 shrinks the model to about a third of its size; the speed gain depends on hardware and operators.
samples.hypothesis: After quantization to int8, the model size is reduced to about one-third, and the speed improvement depends on the hardware and operators.

samples.source: 半精度 fp16 保留浮点动态范围，训练时用得多；int8 推理时用得多。
samples.reference: Half-precision fp16 keeps the dynamic range of floats and is used heavily in training; int8 is used heavily in inference.
samples.hypothesis: Half-precision fp16 retains the dynamic range of floating-point numbers and is commonly used during training; int8 is frequently used during inference.

samples.source: 知识蒸馏把大模型的软标签灌给小模型，让后者逼近前者的准确率。
samples.reference: Knowledge distillation feeds the soft labels of a large model into a small model so the latter approaches the former's accuracy.
samples.hypothesis: Knowledge distillation transfers the soft labels of a large model to a smaller model, allowing the latter to approach the former's accuracy.

samples.source: 教师模型可以是 30B 参数，学生模型压到 1B，蒸馏后小模型在窄任务上不掉太多。
samples.reference: The teacher might have 30B parameters and the student only 1B; a distilled student loses surprisingly little on a narrow task.
samples.hypothesis: The teacher model can have 30B parameters, while the student model is reduced to 1B. After distillation, the small model performs well on narrow tasks without significant performance loss.

samples.source: 微调在特定领域语料上继续训练，学习率要显著低于预训练阶段。
samples.reference: Fine-tuning continues training on a domain-specific corpus at a much lower learning rate than pretraining.
samples.hypothesis: Fine-tuning should continue on a specific domain corpus, with a learning rate significantly lower than that of the pre-training phase.

samples.source: LoRA 只训练两个低秩矩阵，参数量与原模型相比不到百分之一。
samples.reference: LoRA only trains two low-rank matrices, less than one percent of the base model's parameter count.
samples.hypothesis: LoRA trains only two low-rank matrices, with fewer parameters than the original model, accounting for less than one percent.

samples.source: 推理时 batch size 越大吞吐越高但延迟也越长，实时场景往往锁死 batch=1。
samples.reference: At inference time, larger batch size raises throughput but also latency; realtime pipelines usually lock batch=1.
samples.hypothesis: When the batch size is larger, throughput increases but latency also grows. Real-time scenarios typically lock in a batch size of 1.

samples.source: 线程数不是越多越好；ONNX 的 inter-op 与 intra-op 要分开调。
samples.reference: More threads are not always better; ONNX's inter-op and intra-op thread counts have to be tuned separately.
samples.hypothesis: The number of threads is not always better the more there are; ONNX's inter-op and intra-op operations should be called separately.

samples.source: 算子融合把多个小算子合并成一个大算子，减少内存往返与调度开销。
samples.reference: Operator fusion collapses several small operators into one, reducing memory round-trips and scheduling overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Operator fusion combines multiple small operators into a single operator to reduce memory traffic and scheduling overhead.

samples.source: 计算图优化是推理框架的核心工作，图切分决定哪些算子留在 CPU 哪些上 GPU。
samples.reference: Computation-graph optimisation is the core work of an inference framework; graph partitioning decides which operators stay on CPU and which move to GPU.
samples.hypothesis: Graph optimization is a core task of inference frameworks, where graph partitioning determines which operators remain on the CPU and which are moved to the GPU.

samples.source: 运行时提供程序的选择影响极大，同一模型在 CUDA 与 CPU 上可能差 5 到 10 倍。
samples.reference: Choosing the runtime provider matters a lot -- the same model can be 5 to 10 times faster on CUDA than on CPU.
samples.hypothesis: The choice of runtime library has a significant impact; the same model can perform 5 to 10 times differently on CUDA versus the CPU.

samples.source: 显存不足时 Ollama 会自动把部分层卸载到内存，速度骤降但不会崩。
samples.reference: When VRAM is insufficient Ollama offloads some layers to main memory; throughput collapses but the process survives.
samples.hypothesis: When VRAM is insufficient, Ollama automatically unloads some layers into memory, causing a sharp drop in speed but preventing crashes.

samples.source: 批大小与序列长度的乘积决定 KV 缓存的显存开销。
samples.reference: The product of batch size and sequence length determines the VRAM cost of the KV cache.
samples.hypothesis: The product of batch size and sequence length determines the VRAM usage of the KV cache.

samples.source: 多语言模型用一份参数覆盖 100 多种语言，冷门语向的质量通常明显低于热门语向。
samples.reference: A multilingual model covers more than a hundred languages with one set of weights, and quality on cold pairs is usually much lower than on hot pairs.
samples.hypothesis: Multilingual models use a single set of parameters to cover over 100 languages, with the quality of less popular language directions typically significantly lower than that of popular ones.

samples.source: 分词器与模型的词表必须严格匹配，错配会导致输出乱码但不报错。
samples.reference: The tokenizer and the model's vocabulary must match exactly; a mismatch produces garbled output without raising an error.
samples.hypothesis: The tokenizer and the model's vocabulary must strictly match. Mismatches will result in garbled output but will not trigger an error.

samples.source: 温度采样把概率分布拉平，让模型输出更多样，但翻译场景通常希望更低温度。
samples.reference: Temperature sampling flattens the probability distribution and yields more varied output, but translation typically wants lower temperature.
samples.hypothesis: Temperature sampling flattens the probability distribution, leading to more diverse model outputs, but translation scenarios typically prefer a lower temperature.

samples.source: 上下文窗口是 LLM 的硬约束，长文档翻译要么截断要么分段喂。
samples.reference: The context window is a hard constraint on the LLM; long documents must be truncated or fed one sentence at a time.
samples.hypothesis: The context window is a hard constraint for LLMs. Translating long documents either requires truncation or feeding them in segments.

samples.source: 系统提示里显式列出术语表可以显著降低专业词错译，但会占用输入 token。
samples.reference: Listing the glossary explicitly inside the system prompt significantly reduces terminology errors but consumes input tokens.
samples.hypothesis: Including a term list in the system prompt can significantly reduce errors in translating professional terms, but it will consume input tokens.

samples.source: 少样本示例把 "用户希望的译法" 直接摆到模型眼前，比抽象指令更有效。
samples.reference: Few-shot examples put the user's preferred rendering directly in front of the model, which beats any abstract instruction.
samples.hypothesis: Present the user's desired translation directly to the model; it's more effective than abstract instructions.

samples.source: 术语表要按当前请求的语言对与领域过滤，把不相关条目喂给模型只会稀释注意力。
samples.reference: Glossaries must be filtered by the current request's language pair and domain; feeding irrelevant rows only dilutes attention.
samples.hypothesis: The terminology list should be filtered according to the current request's language and domain. Feeding irrelevant entries to the model will only dilute focus.

samples.source: 翻译记忆是精确匹配，命中即零成本；模糊匹配是另一码事，会引入排序噪声。
samples.reference: Translation memory matches exactly -- a hit is zero-cost; fuzzy matching is a different problem and brings ranking noise.
samples.hypothesis: Translation memory is for exact matches, which incurs zero cost upon a hit; fuzzy matching is a different matter, as it introduces sorting noise.

samples.source: 置信度门控是本地结果与 AI 升级之间的开关，阈值定太松会白白多花一次 API。
samples.reference: Confidence gating is the switch between local output and AI upgrade; too permissive a threshold wastes API calls.
samples.hypothesis: Confidence threshold gating acts as a switch between local results and AI upgrades. Setting the threshold too loosely will result in an unnecessary extra API call.

samples.source: 质量分记录每条 TM 的历史可信度，AI 写入通常是 0.95，本地是估算，手动是 1.0。
samples.reference: The quality score records each TM entry's historical reliability -- AI writes at 0.95, local estimates its own, manual writes 1.0.

samples.source: 翻译记忆与术语表解决的是不同问题：前者复用整句历史，后者约束单词译法。
samples.reference: Translation memory and glossary solve different problems: the first reuses whole-sentence history, the second constrains word-level rendering.
samples.hypothesis: Translation memory and terminology solve different problems: the former reuses entire historical sentences, while the latter constrains word translations.

samples.source: 置信度分数应该跟译文本身绑定，而不是跟引擎绑定；同一模型不同批次的输出置信度会漂移。
samples.reference: Confidence should be bound to the translation itself, not to the engine -- the same model can drift across batches.
samples.hypothesis: Confidence scores should be tied to the translated text itself, not the engine itself; confidence scores can drift across different batches from the same model.

samples.source: 兜底降级路径要保留请求上下文，让下一层能知道上一层为什么没走通。
samples.reference: A fallback path must preserve request context so the next layer can see why the previous one did not run.
samples.hypothesis: The fallback降级 path must retain the request context so that the next layer can understand why the previous layer failed.

samples.source: 不静默降级要求响应 message 字段携带完整原因链，调用方据此决定重试还是提示用户。
samples.reference: No-silent-degradation requires the response message to carry the full causal chain so the caller can decide to retry or prompt the user.
samples.hypothesis: The non-silent downgrade requires the response message to carry a complete chain of reasons, allowing the caller to decide whether to retry or prompt the user.

samples.source: 上下文窗口是 LLM 硬约束，长文档翻译要么截断要么按句喂，不能整段塞进去。
samples.reference: The context window is a hard constraint on the LLM; long documents must be truncated or fed one sentence at a time, never stuffed whole.
samples.hypothesis: The context window is a hard constraint for LLMs. Translating long documents either requires truncation or feeding them sentence by sentence; you cannot fit the entire text in one go.

samples.source: 少样本示例条数不是越多越好，5 条高质量示例往往优于 20 条低质量示例。
samples.reference: More few-shot examples are not always better -- five high-quality examples often beat twenty low-quality ones.
samples.hypothesis: A smaller number of high-quality examples is often better than a larger number of low-quality ones.

samples.source: 蒸馏的入库阈值决定了术语表的信噪比，太松会让错误术语污染后续所有请求。
samples.reference: The distillation store threshold determines glossary signal-to-noise; too permissive lets wrong terms pollute every subsequent request.
samples.hypothesis: The threshold for distilled term entry determines the signal-to-noise ratio of the terminology list. A too-loose threshold will cause incorrect terms to contaminate all subsequent requests.

samples.source: 术语注入到提示词中要显式约束格式，不然模型会把中文术语当成解释性文本。
samples.reference: Term injection into the prompt must specify format explicitly, otherwise the model reads the Chinese terms as explanatory prose.
samples.hypothesis: Explicitly inject the terminology into the prompt to enforce the format; otherwise, the model will treat the Chinese terms as explanatory text.

samples.source: 多语言模型对冷门语言对的表现受限于训练语料规模，不是模型容量。
samples.reference: A multilingual model's performance on cold pairs is bound by training corpus size, not model capacity.
samples.hypothesis: The performance of multilingual models on less common language pairs is limited by the size of their training corpus, not by model capacity.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译的分词器与训练语料绑定，跨语料使用时词表命中率会骤降。
samples.reference: Neural machine translation's tokenizer is bound to its training corpus; using it on a different corpus makes the vocabulary hit rate collapse.
samples.hypothesis: The neural machine translation tokenizer is tied to its training corpus, leading to a sharp drop in vocabulary accuracy when used across different corpora.

samples.source: 大语言模型可以做机器翻译，但对提示工程敏感，同一个源句换个提示可能质量差一档。
samples.reference: A large language model can do machine translation but is sensitive to prompt engineering -- the same source sentence can differ by a tier depending on the prompt.
samples.hypothesis: Large language models can perform machine translation, but they are sensitive to prompt engineering. The quality can vary significantly if the same source sentence is translated with different prompts.

samples.source: 自动评测不能替代人工评测；chrF/BLEU 与 COMET 与人工评分之间相关系数在窄域上会明显下降。
samples.reference: Automatic evaluation cannot replace human evaluation; on narrow domains the correlation between chrF/BLEU/COMET and human judgement drops noticeably.
samples.hypothesis: Automated evaluation cannot replace human evaluation; the correlation coefficient between chrF/BLEU, COMET, and human scores will significantly decrease in narrow domains.

samples.source: 统计机器翻译的短语表在语序差异大的语对之间退化严重，比如中文到芬兰语。
samples.reference: Phrase tables in statistical machine translation degrade badly for pairs with large word-order gaps, e.g. Chinese to Finnish.
samples.hypothesis: Statistical machine translation phrase tables suffer severe degradation between language pairs with significant syntactic differences, such as from Chinese to Finnish.

samples.source: 翻译记忆的模糊匹配按编辑距离或语义距离排序，返回的 top-k 数量要克制。
samples.reference: Fuzzy match over translation memory sorts by edit distance or semantic distance; the returned top-k must stay small to avoid noise.
samples.hypothesis: The fuzzy matching of memory translations is sorted by edit distance or semantic distance, with the top-k number of results being kept minimal.

samples.source: 置信度门控在实时档要更严，因为实时档不接受升级；在精译档可以稍松，因为 AI 兜底。
samples.reference: Confidence gating has to be stricter in realtime mode because realtime does not allow upgrade, and looser in quality mode because AI provides a floor.
samples.hypothesis: The confidence gate should be stricter in real-time mode, as real-time mode does not accept upgrades. It can be slightly looser in the precision translation mode, as the AI serves as a safety net.

samples.source: 术语注入到本地引擎与注入到 LLM 的效果不一样：本地引擎把它当硬约束，LLM 会理解上下文再决定。
samples.reference: Term injection behaves differently on local engines versus LLMs: local treats it as a hard constraint, LLMs integrate it into context before deciding.
samples.hypothesis: Injecting the term into a local engine produces a different effect than injecting it into an LLM: the local engine treats it as a hard constraint, while the LLM will decide based on understanding the context.

samples.source: 蒸馏产出要区分 "用户已确认" 与 "机器自抽"，前者可以覆盖后者，反之不行。
samples.reference: Distillation output must distinguish "user confirmed" from "machine extracted"; the first can overwrite the second, not the other way round.
samples.hypothesis: Distilled outputs must distinguish between "user-confirmed" and "machine-generated"; the former can override the latter, but the reverse does not apply.

samples.source: 命中率与延迟之间通常正相关；命中率越高说明重复内容越多，缓存路径也越快。
samples.reference: Hit rate and latency are usually positively correlated -- a higher hit rate means more repeated content and faster cached paths.
samples.hypothesis: Accuracy and latency are generally positively correlated; higher accuracy indicates more repeated content, which also makes the cache path faster.

samples.source: 端到端语音翻译里 ASR 的错误会传染给 MT，再传染给 TTS，因此段级评估要独立跑。
samples.reference: In end-to-end speech translation, ASR errors propagate into MT and then into TTS, so segment-level evaluation has to run independently.
samples.hypothesis: In end-to-end voice translation, errors from ASR can propagate to MT, which then affects TTS. Therefore, segment-level evaluation must be performed independently.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译的注意力可视化能揭示模型 "看到" 了源句的哪一部分，但不等于可解释性。
samples.reference: Attention visualisation reveals which part of the source the model "looked at" but is not the same as interpretability.
samples.hypothesis: Attention visualization in neural machine translation can reveal which parts of the source sentence the model "sees," but it does not equate to interpretability.

samples.source: 翻译记忆的更新策略是 last-write-wins 还是 best-quality-wins，产品语义完全不同。
samples.reference: Whether translation memory uses last-write-wins or best-quality-wins yields entirely different product semantics.
samples.hypothesis: The update strategy for memory translation is last-write-wins or best-quality-wins, which have completely different product semantics.

samples.source: 大语言模型的 prompt injection 是隐私风险的来源之一，术语表内容不能包含可执行指令。
samples.reference: Prompt injection is one source of privacy risk for LLMs; glossary content must never include executable instructions.
samples.hypothesis: Large language model prompt injection is one of the sources of privacy risks; the terminology list must not include executable instructions.

samples.source: 翻译引擎的兜底不是简单的 "翻不出来返回原文"，而是要明确 "为什么没翻出来"。
samples.reference: A translation engine's fallback is not a simple "return original on failure" -- it must state why the translation did not happen.
samples.hypothesis: The fallback of a professional offline translation engine isn't simply "can't translate and returns the original text"; it should clearly state "why it couldn't be translated."

samples.source: 端到端评估的样本要覆盖短句、中句、长句三档，短多义词与长复杂句的失败模式不同。
samples.reference: End-to-end evaluation samples must cover short, medium and long sentences -- short polysemy and long complex sentences fail in different ways.
samples.hypothesis: The samples for end-to-end evaluation should cover short sentences, medium-length sentences, and long sentences, as the failure patterns for short multi-meaning words and long complex sentences are different.

samples.source: 用户锁定条目优先级最高：蒸馏不能覆盖，导入种子包也不能覆盖，除非用户显式撤销。
samples.reference: User-locked entries have the highest priority: neither distillation nor seed-pack imports may overwrite them unless the user explicitly unlocks them.
samples.hypothesis: The entry is locked with the highest priority: it cannot be overwritten by distillation, nor by importing a seed package, unless the user explicitly reverts it.

samples.source: 麦克风增益过高会让削波后的波形失去可识别性，ASR 会明显退化。
samples.reference: Microphone gain that is too high produces clipped waveforms with no recognisable content and degrades ASR visibly.
samples.hypothesis: Excessive microphone gain will make the waveform after compression unrecognizable, leading to significant degradation of ASR performance.

samples.source: 扬声器输出的音量归一化要放在编码前而不是解码后，否则动态范围会丢。
samples.reference: Loudness normalisation for loudspeaker output must happen before encoding, not after decoding, or the dynamic range is lost.
samples.hypothesis: The volume normalization of the speaker output should be done before encoding, not after decoding, otherwise the dynamic range will be lost.

samples.source: 录音的静音剪裁要在 VAD 判定后做，不能在波形上做简单的能量阈值。
samples.reference: Silence trimming must follow VAD decisions rather than a naive energy threshold on the raw waveform.
samples.hypothesis: Silent trimming of the recording should be performed after VAD detection; simple energy thresholds on the waveform are not acceptable.

samples.source: 播放头跨段跳变时要触发一次 flush，不然缓冲里会残留上一段的音频。
samples.reference: Cross-segment playhead jumps must trigger a flush, otherwise the previous segment's audio stays in the buffer.
samples.hypothesis: When the playhead jumps across segments, a flush should be triggered; otherwise, the previous segment's audio will remain in the buffer.

samples.source: 时间轴面板要区分视频帧号与音频样本号；两者换算依赖帧率与采样率。
samples.reference: The timeline panel must distinguish video frame indices from audio sample indices; converting between them depends on frame rate and sample rate.
samples.hypothesis: The timeline panel needs to distinguish between video frame numbers and audio sample numbers; the conversion between them depends on the frame rate and sampling rate.

samples.source: 导入含 BOM 的字幕文件要能识别并剥离 BOM，不然首行字幕会带上不可见字符。
samples.reference: Importing a subtitle file that contains a BOM must detect and strip it, or the first line carries an invisible character.
samples.hypothesis: When importing subtitle files containing BOM, the BOM must be recognized and stripped off; otherwise, the first line of subtitles will contain invisible characters.

samples.source: 导出为 SRT 时的时间戳精度到毫秒即可；ASS 需要到厘秒，两者格式不同。
samples.reference: SRT export needs millisecond precision; ASS uses centiseconds -- the two formats are not interchangeable.
samples.hypothesis: The time stamp precision for exporting as SRT should be down to milliseconds; for ASS, it needs to be down to hundredths of a second. The formats are different.

samples.source: 预览窗口按软字幕渲染，让用户能开关字幕轨；导出选项要与之解耦。
samples.reference: The preview pane renders soft subtitles so users can toggle tracks; the export option must stay decoupled from this choice.
samples.hypothesis: The preview window should render using soft subtitles, allowing users to enable or disable the subtitle track. Export options should be decoupled from this.

samples.source: 剪辑导出时如果只改时间轴不改内容，重封装就够，不要引入不必要的二压。
samples.reference: When exporting an edit that only changes timing and not content, remuxing is enough -- do not introduce unnecessary re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: When editing and exporting, if only the timeline is changed without altering the content, re-packaging is sufficient; avoid introducing unnecessary re-compression.

samples.source: 波形视图与频谱视图是互补的：前者看能量分布，后者看频率分布。
samples.reference: Waveform and spectrogram views are complementary: the first shows energy distribution, the second shows frequency distribution.
samples.hypothesis: The waveform view and the spectrum view are complementary: the former shows energy distribution, while the latter shows frequency distribution.

samples.source: 麦克风阵列的波束成形能显著提升远处说话人的信噪比，前提是采样同步。
samples.reference: Beam-forming on a microphone array markedly improves signal-to-noise for distant speakers, provided sample sync is preserved.
samples.hypothesis: Beamforming of a microphone array can significantly improve the signal-to-noise ratio for distant speakers, provided that sampling is synchronized.

samples.source: 导出前一次性校验源与目标的采样率、声道、位深三项，不匹配就提示。
samples.reference: Before export, verify sample rate, channels and bit depth in one pass and prompt on mismatch.
samples.hypothesis: Before exporting, verify the source and target sample rate, channel count, and bit depth. If any of them do not match, a prompt will be displayed.

samples.source: 音频格式转换要显式选择是否重采样，重采样要声明是否走高质量滤波器。
samples.reference: Audio format conversion must let the caller choose whether to resample, and resampling must declare whether to use a high-quality filter.
samples.hypothesis: For audio format conversion, explicitly specify whether to perform resampling. For resampling, declare whether to use a high-quality filter.

samples.source: 项目里所有对外承诺的数字都要有实测来源；预估值一律标注 "估算"。
samples.reference: Every outward-published number in this project must trace back to a measured run; estimates are labelled "estimated" without exception.
samples.hypothesis: All figures made publicly in the project must have actual testing sources; preliminary estimates must be labeled as "estimates".

samples.source: 侧车进程只监听本机回环，任何对外暴露都是明确的隐私不变量违背。
samples.reference: The sidecar binds only to the local loopback, and any external exposure would violate the privacy invariant explicitly.
samples.hypothesis: The sidecar process only listens to the local loopback; any exposure to the outside world is a clear violation of privacy invariants.

samples.source: 语言对分档决定了走哪个引擎；冷门语对可能压根就没有本地引擎可选。
samples.reference: Language-pair tiering decides which engine runs; cold pairs may not have any local engine at all.
samples.hypothesis: Language determines which engine to use for segmentation; for niche languages, there might be no local engine available at all.

samples.source: 交付离线整合包时用户环境可能是离线内网，模型与词表都不能靠运行时下载。
samples.reference: When delivering an offline bundle the customer environment might be an air-gapped network, so neither models nor vocabularies may rely on runtime download.
samples.hypothesis: When delivering the offline integration package, the user environment may be an offline internal network, where neither the model nor the vocabulary can be downloaded at runtime.

samples.source: 精译档的质量承诺包括 "AI 可达时尽量升级"，不是 "永远走本地"。
samples.reference: Quality mode promises "escalate to AI when reachable", not "stay local forever".
samples.hypothesis: The quality commitment for the refined document includes "upgrading whenever AI is feasible," not "always using local processing."

samples.source: 实时档的延迟预算是硬约束，任何会打破预算的功能（比如 AI 升级）都要显式禁用。
samples.reference: The latency budget in realtime mode is a hard constraint; anything that would break it, AI upgrade included, must be explicitly disabled.
samples.hypothesis: The real-time data delay budget is a hard constraint. Any feature that would exceed this budget (such as AI upgrades) must be explicitly disabled.

samples.source: 质量偏好在设置页二选一，保存后重启生效，避免运行中改路由造成状态混乱。
samples.reference: The quality-preference toggle is a two-way choice in settings; changes take effect only on restart so routing cannot mutate mid-flight.
samples.hypothesis: Quality preference can be selected from two options on the settings page. After saving, restart the application to take effect, to prevent routing changes during operation from causing state confusion.

samples.source: 兜底降级要区分 "本地模型缺失" 与 "外部引擎不可达"，前者可提示下载，后者要重试。
samples.reference: Fallback must distinguish "local model missing" from "external engine unreachable"; the first invites a download, the second a retry.
samples.hypothesis: For fallback降级, differentiate between "local model missing" and "external engine unreachable". For the former, you can prompt the user to download; for the latter, retry the request.

samples.source: 模型许可矩阵是产品对外承诺的一部分，任何新增依赖都要过许可门禁。
samples.reference: The model-licence matrix is part of the outward commitment; every new dependency goes through the licence gate.
samples.hypothesis: The model approval matrix is part of the product's external commitments; any new dependencies must pass the approval gate.

samples.source: 执行提供程序的切换要走环境变量，不要写死在源码里。
samples.reference: Execution-provider selection must go through environment variables, never hard-coded in source.
samples.hypothesis: To switch the provider, you need to modify the environment variables; do not hardcode it in the source code.

samples.source: 路由决策是可观测的：每次翻译的 route_plan 都能通过诊断接口读回。
samples.reference: Routing is observable: every translation exposes its route_plan over the diagnostics interface.
samples.hypothesis: Route decisions are observable: the route_plan from each translation can be read back via the diagnostic interface.

samples.source: 本地引擎与云端引擎之间是硬边界，隐私模式关闭这条边界上的所有通路。
samples.reference: Local engines and cloud engines are a hard boundary; privacy mode closes every path across that boundary.
samples.hypothesis: The local engine and the cloud engine are separated by a hard boundary. All pathways on this boundary are closed in privacy mode.

samples.source: 翻译流水线是数据驱动的：路由表可以改，未识别的配置键要显式回传不静默丢弃。
samples.reference: The translation pipeline is data-driven: routes can be edited, and any unknown configuration key is echoed back rather than silently dropped.
samples.hypothesis: The translation pipeline is data-driven: the routing table can be modified, and unrecognizable configuration keys must be explicitly retransmitted without being silently discarded.

samples.source: 置信度估算不是模型输出概率，是模型质量启发式的合成，产品要如实说明。
samples.reference: Confidence estimation is not a raw model probability; it is a synthesis of quality heuristics, and the product says so.
samples.hypothesis: Confidence estimation is not the model's output probability but rather a heuristic synthesis of model quality, which the product should accurately describe.

samples.source: 端到端语音闭环的模型体积上限约 500 MB，超了就不适合首装下载。
samples.reference: The end-to-end speech loop caps around 500 MB of model weight; anything larger is unfit for a first-launch download.
samples.hypothesis: The end-to-end voice closed-loop model has a maximum size of approximately 500 MB. If it exceeds this, it is not suitable for initial installation and download.

samples.source: 实时同传产品在演示阶段常被称为 "转写 + 翻译"，不承诺 "同传" 是产品叙事纪律。
samples.reference: Real-time interpretation products in the demo phase say "transcription plus translation"; promising "interpretation" is a narrative-discipline violation.
samples.hypothesis: Real-time simultaneous translation products are often referred to as "transcription + translation" during their demonstration phase, with no commitment to "simultaneous interpretation" as part of the product narrative.

samples.source: 批量本地化管线要能导入 mp4 抽音、走 ASR 转写、翻译、再回写软字幕，四步都能中断续跑。
samples.reference: A batch localization pipeline should be able to import mp4, extract audio, run ASR, translate, and write soft subtitles back -- all four steps interruptible and resumable.
samples.hypothesis: The batch localization pipeline should be able to import MP4 audio, perform ASR transcription, translation, and then re-write soft subtitles, with all four steps running continuously.

samples.source: 涉密文档场景要求所有本地组件都可离线获取，联网功能要能整体禁用。
samples.reference: Confidential-document scenarios require every local component to be obtainable offline; network features must be globally disableable.
samples.hypothesis: For confidential documents, all local components must be obtainable offline, and the online functionality must be completely disabled.

samples.source: 桌面客户端要显示每次翻译实际走了哪个引擎，"透明可追溯" 是本产品的基本承诺。
samples.reference: The desktop client shows which engine actually ran each translation -- transparent traceability is a baseline promise of this product.
samples.hypothesis: The desktop client must display which engine was actually used for each translation. "Transparency and traceability" is a fundamental promise of this product.

samples.source: 翻译记忆导出要能带走或分享，但术语表按领域打包发布时不能携带用户私有条目。
samples.reference: Translation memory exports must be portable and shareable; but glossary seed packs must not carry user-private entries.
samples.hypothesis: The translation memory should be portable for personal use or sharing. However, when the terminology list is published by field, it cannot include the user's private entries.

samples.source: 端到端延迟由 VAD、ASR、MT、TTS 四段串联，任何一段劣化都会顶到用户脸上。
samples.reference: End-to-end latency is the sum of VAD, ASR, MT and TTS; degradation in any one of them lands squarely on the user's face.
samples.hypothesis: End-to-end latency is caused by four sequential stages: VAD, ASR, MT, and TTS. Any degradation in any of these stages will be immediately noticeable to the user.

samples.source: 批处理任务的日志要按句粒度落盘，失败重跑时能精确恢复到出错那一条而不是从头再来。
samples.reference: Batch job logs must persist per sentence, so a failed rerun can resume precisely at the erroring item rather than start over.
samples.hypothesis: Batch task logs should be saved at the sentence level so that when a failed task is retried, it can precisely restore to the specific error line instead of starting over from the beginning.

samples.source: 长文档翻译要按段落或章节切分喂入，段间的一致性靠翻译记忆与术语表共同保证。
samples.reference: Long-document translation is fed segment-by-segment or section-by-section, and cross-segment consistency is carried by translation memory plus glossary.
samples.hypothesis: Long documents should be fed in by paragraph or chapter sections, with consistency between sections guaranteed by translation memory and terminology databases.

samples.source: 多说话人播客的本地化要先把不同说话人分流到各自的合成通道，再按时间线合流。
samples.reference: Localising a multi-speaker podcast first routes each diarised speaker into their own synthesis channel, then rejoins them along the timeline.
samples.hypothesis: For a multi-speaker podcast, first separate each speaker into their own synthesis channels, then combine them according to the timeline.

samples.source: 涉密客户的批量本地化通常要求现场部署，任何遥测都要能整体禁用。
samples.reference: Confidential clients typically require on-premise delivery of batch localization, and any telemetry must be globally disableable.
samples.hypothesis: Batch localization for confidential clients typically requires on-site deployment, and any remote monitoring must be completely disabled.

samples.source: 术语表的导入接口对包级 domain、source_lang、target_lang 三项做强制校验，防止污染通用表。
samples.reference: The glossary import endpoint enforces pack-level domain, source_lang and target_lang to prevent polluting the generic table.
samples.hypothesis: The import interface for the terminology list enforces mandatory validation for package-level domain, source language, and target language to prevent contamination of the shared vocabulary.

samples.source: 翻译请求体的 domain 字段透传到 TM 命中的判断，跨 domain 的记忆不复用避免语境错配。
samples.reference: The request's domain field propagates into the TM hit check, so cross-domain memory is refused to avoid context mis-fit.
samples.hypothesis: The domain field of the request body should be passed through to the TM's matching judgment to prevent cross-domain memory reuse and context mismatches.

samples.source: 蒸馏 worker 是异步的，队列满时直接丢弃不阻塞主路径；这在延迟与完整性之间选了前者。
samples.reference: The distillation worker is asynchronous; when its queue is full it drops candidates rather than blocking the main path -- a deliberate latency-over-completeness choice.
samples.hypothesis: The distillation worker is asynchronous; when the queue is full, it discards the task without blocking the main path. This prioritizes latency over data integrity.

samples.source: 路由表是数据驱动的：routes.json、settings.json、环境变量、初始化 JSON 四级优先级依次覆盖。
samples.reference: The routing table is data-driven with four precedence levels in order: routes.json < settings.json < environment variables < initialisation JSON.
samples.hypothesis: The routing table is data-driven, with routes.json, settings.json, environment variables, and the initial JSON file having priority levels in descending order.

samples.source: 端到端评测的样本要按子领域打标签，才能算出 "流水线核心 vs 多义词边界" 的分组质量差。
samples.reference: End-to-end evaluation samples carry sub-domain labels so per-group quality deltas ("pipeline core vs polysemy boundary") can be computed.
samples.hypothesis: The end-to-end evaluation samples need to be labeled by sub-domain to accurately calculate the poor grouping quality between "assembly line core" and "polysem edge."

samples.source: 批量本地化的性能指标是 "每小时能翻多少段"，与实时场景的 "端到端多少毫秒" 是两套。
samples.reference: The performance metric for batch localisation is sentences per hour; the realtime metric is end-to-end milliseconds -- two completely different scales.
samples.hypothesis: The performance metric for batch localization is "how many segments can be translated per hour," which is a different set of metrics from the real-time scenario's "end-to-end latency in milliseconds."

samples.source: 桌面产品的首次启动体验很重要：模型缺失时要在 UI 里明说而不是抛异常。
samples.reference: The first-launch experience of a desktop product matters: missing models must surface as a friendly UI message, not an exception.
samples.hypothesis: The first-time startup experience for desktop products is crucial: when a model is missing, it should be clearly indicated in the UI instead of throwing an exception.

samples.source: 本地模型的下载要能显示进度并支持断点续传，几百 MB 到几 GB 的模型不适合一刀断重来。
samples.reference: Local model downloads must show progress and support resumable fetch; hundreds of megabytes to gigabytes are not worth restarting from zero.
samples.hypothesis: The local model download must display progress and support resume from a point, as models ranging from several hundred MB to several GB are not suitable for a single re-download.

samples.source: 精译档与实时档的切换粒度是每请求；同一批里可以混着走，不用切档。
samples.reference: Switching between quality and realtime mode happens per request; a single batch can freely mix them without a global toggle.
samples.hypothesis: The switch granularity between the refined draft and real-time draft is per request; they can be mixed within the same batch without needing to switch drafts.

samples.source: sidecar 的生命周期由 UI 层管理，启动时轮询健康检查，退出时优雅 kill。
samples.reference: The sidecar's lifecycle is managed by the UI layer -- health-poll on startup, graceful kill on shutdown.
samples.hypothesis: The sidecar's lifecycle is managed by the UI layer. It performs health checks on startup and gracefully shuts down upon exit.

samples.source: Python 侧车与 Rust 核心之间是 HTTP/JSON 契约，禁止 native binding 引入新的依赖负担。
samples.reference: The contract between the Python sidecar and the Rust core is HTTP over JSON, with native bindings forbidden so no new dependency burden creeps in.
samples.hypothesis: The Python side and the Rust core use an HTTP/JSON contract, prohibiting native bindings from introducing new dependency burdens.

samples.source: Windows 智能应用控制会拦截未签名的本地构建 DLL，产品发布签名要覆盖所有二进制。
samples.reference: Windows Smart App Control intercepts unsigned locally built DLLs, so product signing must cover every binary shipped.
samples.hypothesis: Windows Smart App Control will block locally built DLLs that are not signed; product release signatures must override all binaries.

samples.source: 许可证门禁覆盖 Cargo.lock、Python requirements、.NET csproj 与文档引用的第三方素材。
samples.reference: The licence gate covers Cargo.lock, Python requirements, .NET csproj files, and any third-party material referenced from the docs.
samples.hypothesis: License access controls cover third-party assets referenced in Cargo.lock, Python requirements, .NET csproj, and documentation.

samples.source: 源码注释统一英文；文档面向中文用户，中英双版按 README 起头互链。
samples.reference: Source-code comments are English throughout; user-facing documentation is Chinese with an English twin linked from the README.
samples.hypothesis: Source code comments should be uniformly in English; the documentation is intended for Chinese users, with a bilingual Chinese-English version starting with the README and linking between them.

samples.source: 所有对外发布的数字都要能追溯到一次可复现的评测运行，含脚本、种子、时间戳。
samples.reference: Every externally published number must trace back to a reproducible evaluation run -- script, seed and timestamp included.
samples.hypothesis: All publicly released numbers must be traceable to a reproducible test run, including scripts, seeds, and timestamps.

samples.source: 文档中不出现机器盘符路径；所有默认路径都走 data_dir 解析。
samples.reference: Docs must not carry machine drive paths; every default path resolves through data_dir.
samples.hypothesis: The document does not contain machine drive paths; all default paths are resolved via data_dir.

samples.source: 构建入口以 Python 脚本为主，Windows 与 Linux 各配一个 .bat / .sh 做 OS 级薄壳。
samples.reference: Build entry points are Python scripts, with a thin .bat on Windows and .sh on Linux as OS-level wrappers.
samples.hypothesis: Create an entry point primarily using a Python script, with a .bat / .sh file for each of Windows and Linux to serve as a thin OS-level wrapper.

samples.source: pre-commit 钩子按路径触发不同检查，全绿才允许 commit。
samples.reference: The pre-commit hook dispatches different checks by file path and only allows a commit when every applicable check passes.
samples.hypothesis: The pre-commit hook triggers different checks based on the path, and a commit is only allowed if all checks pass.

samples.source: Conventional Commits 是提交信息规范，type(scope): subject 一行说清 "改了什么的哪部分"。
samples.reference: Conventional Commits is the message convention: type(scope): subject says "what changed in which part" in a single line.
samples.hypothesis: Conventional Commits is a submission information standard where one line with type(scope): subject clearly states "what part was changed".

samples.source: pathspec 限定提交是并发协作下的原子性保障；共享暂存区容易被别的会话扫走。
