samples.reference: Pathspec-scoped commits are the atomicity guarantee in concurrent collaboration; a shared staging area is easily swept by another session's commit.
samples.hypothesis: pathspec ensures atomicity for concurrent collaborative submissions; shared temporary storage can easily be cleared by other sessions.

samples.source: patch 文件要显式说明行尾策略，Windows 下 autocrlf=true 检出可能破坏 git apply。
samples.reference: Patch files must state their line-ending policy explicitly; under autocrlf=true on Windows a checkout may otherwise break git apply.
samples.hypothesis: The patch file must explicitly specify the line-end strategy. On Windows, setting autocrlf=true during detection might interfere with git apply.

samples.source: "缓存" 在 CDN 语境是 cache，在视频缓冲语境通常是 buffer；两者混用会误导读者。
samples.reference: "缓存" is cache in a CDN context but buffer in a video buffering context; conflating them misleads the reader.
samples.hypothesis: cache

samples.source: "编码器" 与 "加密器" 中文近似但英文完全不同：encoder 与 encryptor，翻译不能滑。
samples.reference: "编码器" and "加密器" are near-homographs in Chinese but encoder and encryptor in English -- the translation must not slide.
samples.hypothesis: encoder and encryptor

samples.source: "解码器" 与 "解密器" 同样易混：decoder 与 decryptor，看是压缩域还是安全域。
samples.reference: "解码器" and "解密器" are equally confusable: decoder versus decryptor -- decide by compression domain or security domain.
samples.hypothesis: "Decoder" and "Decryptor" are easily confused: it depends on whether it's in the compression domain or the security domain.

samples.source: "关键帧" 是 video keyframe；"关键帧动画" 是 animation keyframe；同名不同物。
samples.reference: A video keyframe and an animation keyframe share the Chinese term "关键帧" but denote different things.
samples.hypothesis: Keyframe

samples.source: "声道" 与 "通道" 在英文都是 channel；中文 UI 要根据域强制选一个不能默认。
samples.reference: "声道" and "通道" both render as channel in English; the UI must pick one explicitly by domain rather than default.
samples.hypothesis: In English, both "声道" (shào chén) and "通道" (cháng dào) translate to "channel". In Chinese UI, one must be forcibly selected based on the domain, and it cannot be left as the default.

samples.source: "分词" 在 NLP 是 tokenization，在中文文本处理还可能是 word segmentation，两者粒度不同。
samples.reference: "分词" is tokenization in NLP but may be word segmentation in Chinese text processing -- the two operate at different granularity.
samples.hypothesis: In NLP, "分词" refers to tokenization, which can also be called word segmentation in Chinese text processing. The granularity of the two is different.

samples.source: "重采样" 在音频域是 resample，在统计域是 bootstrap 采样；上下文域决定译法。
samples.reference: "重采样" in audio is resampling; in statistics it is bootstrap sampling -- the surrounding domain decides the rendering.
samples.hypothesis: In the audio domain, "重采样" is called resample; in the statistical domain, it is bootstrap sampling. The context determines the translation.

samples.source: "预训练" 与 "预热" 在中文里都含 "pre"，英文是 pretraining 与 warmup，工程语义完全不同。
samples.reference: "预训练" and "预热" both start with "pre-" in Chinese, but they are pretraining and warmup in English -- completely different engineering meanings.
samples.hypothesis: Pretraining and warmup both contain the prefix "pre" in Chinese, but their meanings in English are completely different in an engineering context.

samples.source: 解码线程卡在队列上时，冲刷一次缓冲区通常就能让流水线重新动起来。
samples.reference: When the decode thread stalls on the queue, flushing the buffer once usually gets the pipeline moving again.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoding thread gets stuck in the queue, clearing the buffer once usually gets the pipeline running again.

samples.source: 背压信号要一路传到采集端，否则缓冲区会在无人察觉时溢出。
samples.reference: The backpressure signal has to reach the capture side, otherwise the buffer overflows without anyone noticing.
samples.hypothesis: The back pressure signal must be continuously transmitted to the acquisition end; otherwise, the buffer will overflow unnoticed.

samples.source: 把分块大小从 20 毫秒调到 40 毫秒，端到端延迟会上升但网络抖动的容忍度变好。
samples.reference: Raising the chunk size from 20 ms to 40 ms increases end-to-end latency but tolerates network jitter better.
samples.hypothesis: Adjusting the block size from 20 milliseconds to 40 milliseconds will increase end-to-end latency but improve tolerance for network jitter.

samples.source: 数据流在中间层被复制两份时，要注意两份的帧序号不能各自递增。
samples.reference: When the data stream is duplicated in the middle layer, the frame numbering of both copies must not advance independently.
samples.hypothesis: When the data stream is replicated twice in the middle layer, ensure that the frame sequence numbers for the two copies do not increment independently.

samples.source: 流水线里任何一段引入线程池，都要重新检查语段结束事件的顺序保证。
samples.reference: Whenever a thread pool is introduced anywhere in the pipeline, the ordering guarantee of speech-segment end events must be rechecked.
samples.hypothesis: In any part of the assembly line that introduces a thread pool, the order of the event end must be rechecked to ensure correctness.

samples.source: 队列长度是观测项，应该和首包延迟一起出现在诊断接口里。
samples.reference: Queue depth is an observable and should appear in the diagnostics endpoint next to time to first packet.
samples.hypothesis: Queue length is an observation item and should appear in the diagnostic interface along with the first packet delay.

samples.source: 流式识别在中途断线后，续传位置要以帧为单位记录而不是以秒为单位。
samples.reference: After streaming recognition is cut off mid-way, the resume position must be recorded in frames rather than in seconds.
samples.hypothesis: After the stream recognition disconnects midway, the subsequent transmission position should be recorded in frames rather than seconds.

samples.source: 分块处理音频时，块边界要对齐到采样点，否则会在交界处产生咔哒声。
samples.reference: When audio is processed in chunks, block boundaries must align to samples, or clicks appear at the seams.
samples.hypothesis: When processing audio in blocks, the block boundaries must align with the sampling points; otherwise, a clicking sound will occur at the transition points.

samples.source: 缓冲策略要显式声明是丢弃最旧还是阻塞生产者，两者语义完全不同。
samples.reference: The buffering policy must state whether it drops the oldest frame or blocks the producer; the two semantics differ completely.
samples.hypothesis: The buffer strategy must explicitly state whether it discards the oldest data or blocks the producer; the semantics of these two options are completely different.

samples.source: 流水线在关闭前要先冲刷所有阶段，否则最后一个语段会静默消失。
samples.reference: The pipeline has to flush every stage before shutdown, otherwise the final speech segment disappears without a trace.
samples.hypothesis: Before the assembly line is shut down, all stages must be cleaned first, otherwise the final segment will silently disappear.

samples.source: 运行时把解码器放在工作线程上，界面线程只负责时间轴刷新。
samples.reference: The runtime puts the decoder on a worker thread, leaving the UI thread to only refresh the timeline.
samples.hypothesis: Place the decoder in the worker thread during runtime, while the UI thread is only responsible for refreshing the timeline.

samples.source: 每帧都重建特征维度的数组会造成明显垃圾回收压力，应当复用缓冲。
samples.reference: Rebuilding the feature-dimension array every frame causes noticeable garbage-collection pressure; reuse the buffer instead.
samples.hypothesis: Reconstructing the feature dimension array for every frame causes significant garbage collection pressure; the buffer should be reused.

samples.source: 推理服务的并发上限应当与队列长度一起上报，便于运维判断排队规模。
samples.reference: An inference service should report its concurrency limit together with queue depth so operators can judge how long the line is.
samples.hypothesis: The concurrency limit for the inference service should be reported along with the queue length, to facilitate operations and maintenance in assessing the queue size.

samples.source: 流式传输的重连策略要区分服务端主动关闭与网络抖动两种情况。
samples.reference: The reconnect policy for streaming transport must separate a server-initiated close from network jitter.
samples.hypothesis: The reconnection strategy for streaming transmission must distinguish between scenarios where the server actively closes the connection and network jitter.

samples.source: 语音分段的边界判定依赖帧移设置，改帧移会同时改变分段粒度。
samples.reference: Segmentation boundaries in voice segmentation depend on the frame shift; changing it also changes segment granularity.
samples.hypothesis: The boundary determination for audio segmentation depends on the frame shift setting; changing the frame shift will also alter the segmentation granularity.

samples.source: 缓冲区水位线要能同时约束延迟与丢帧率，只设上限是不够的。
samples.reference: A buffer watermark has to bound latency and frame loss together; an upper limit alone is not enough.
samples.hypothesis: The buffer waterline must simultaneously constrain both latency and frame drop rate; setting only an upper limit is insufficient.

samples.source: 当解码速度低于采集速度时，背压会把等待时间转移到编码器队列上。
samples.reference: When decoding runs slower than capture, backpressure shifts the waiting onto the encoder queue.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoding speed is lower than the sampling speed, back pressure will shift the waiting time to the encoder queue.

samples.source: 检查点加载完成后要先做一次预热推理，再接受第一个请求。
samples.reference: After a checkpoint is loaded, run one warm-up inference before accepting the first request.
samples.hypothesis: After the checkpoint is loaded, perform a preheating inference first before accepting the first request.

samples.source: 流水线阶段的日志要带上语段编号，否则跨段问题无法归因。
samples.reference: Log lines for each pipeline stage should carry the speech-segment id, or cross-segment issues cannot be attributed.
samples.hypothesis: Log entries at the assembly line stage must include paragraph numbers; otherwise, cross-paragraph issues cannot be identified.

samples.source: 模型权重热更新时要冻结当前队列，等所有在飞请求结束后再替换。
samples.reference: Hot-swapping model weights must freeze the queue and wait for in-flight requests before the replacement.
samples.hypothesis: When performing model weight hot updates, freeze the current queue and wait until all pending requests are completed before replacement.

samples.source: 词元数量超限的长文档要按段落切分喂入，而不是整段截断。
samples.reference: Long documents that exceed the token limit must be fed paragraph by paragraph rather than truncated as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Long documents with an exceeded token limit should be segmented by paragraph and fed in, rather than being truncated as a single block.

samples.source: 子词切分语言的重试策略要按词元计费上限设计，而非按句子数量。
samples.reference: Retry limits for subword-segmented languages should be designed around the token budget, not a sentence count.
samples.hypothesis: The retry strategy for subword segmentation should be designed based on the character-based billing limit, not the number of sentences.

samples.source: 运行时提供两个内存池，一个给帧缓冲，一个给特征张量。
samples.reference: The runtime offers two memory pools, one for the frame buffer and one for feature tensors.
samples.hypothesis: During runtime, two memory pools are provided: one for the frame buffer and another for the feature tensors.

samples.source: 分块边界与强制对齐的时间戳要对齐到同一采样点基准。
samples.reference: Chunk boundaries and forced-alignment timestamps must share one sample-based reference.
samples.hypothesis: The block boundaries and forced alignment timestamps must be aligned to the same sampling point reference.

samples.source: 流式合成输出的第一段要包含完整帧，播放器才不会在开头消音。
samples.reference: The first block emitted by streaming synthesis must contain whole frames, or the player goes silent at the start.
samples.hypothesis: The first segment of the streaming synthesis output must include a complete frame to prevent the player from silencing it at the beginning.

samples.source: 队列满时的丢弃策略要写进响应说明，不能让调用方以为全部处理完成。
samples.reference: If a full queue causes drops, say so in the response instead of letting the caller believe everything was processed.
samples.hypothesis: The discard policy when the queue is full must be included in the response description to prevent the caller from assuming that all processing is complete.

samples.source: 解码器输出的声道顺序要与容器声明一致，左右声道颠倒很难被听见。
samples.reference: The decoder's channel order must match the container's declaration; swapped stereo channels are hard to hear.
samples.hypothesis: The audio channel order output by the decoder must match what is declared in the container; reversing left and right channels will be difficult to hear.

samples.source: 端到端评测要按阶段拆开计时，采集到推理的间隔常常被忽略。
samples.reference: End-to-end evaluation should time each stage; the gap between capture and inference is often overlooked.
samples.hypothesis: End-to-end evaluation should be timed by stage, and the interval from data collection to inference is often overlooked.

samples.source: 推理线程绑核能减少抖动，但会让队列在单核机器上更容易积压。
samples.reference: Pinning inference threads reduces jitter but lets the queue build up more easily on single-core machines.
samples.hypothesis: The inference thread binding to a core reduces jitter, but it also makes the queue more prone to accumulation on single-core machines.

samples.source: 帧缓冲的容量按秒换算时，要用采样率与特征维度共同决定。
samples.reference: Converting the frame buffer from seconds to bytes needs both the sample rate and the feature dimension.
samples.hypothesis: The capacity of frame buffer, when converted per second, is jointly determined by the sampling rate and feature dimension.

samples.source: 数据流合并后要重新编号，否则下游无法判断哪个语段先结束。
samples.reference: Merged data streams require renumbering, or downstream stages cannot tell which speech segment ends first.
samples.hypothesis: After merging the data streams, they need to be renumbered; otherwise, the downstream process will not be able to determine which segment ends first.

samples.source: 冲刷操作必须是幂等的，重复调用不能把队列清空两次。
samples.reference: A flush must be idempotent; calling it twice must not empty the queue twice.
samples.hypothesis: The flush operation must be idempotent; repeated calls should not empty the queue twice.

samples.source: 流水线监控至少要暴露各阶段队列长度与最老请求等待时间。
samples.reference: Pipeline monitoring should expose per-stage queue depth and the age of the oldest request.
samples.hypothesis: Line production monitoring must expose the queue length at each stage and the waiting time for the oldest request.

samples.source: 语言代码在内部一律用规范形式，展示层再本地化，避免比较分叉。
samples.reference: Language codes stay canonical internally and are localized only at display time, to avoid comparison forks.
samples.hypothesis: Language codes should all be standardized internally, with the display layer handling localization to avoid branching.

samples.source: 自动语音识别与翻译阶段共享同一个词表缓存，能省下重复初始化。
samples.reference: Sharing one vocabulary cache between automatic speech recognition and translation saves repeated initialization.
samples.hypothesis: The automatic speech recognition and translation stages share the same vocabulary cache, which saves repeated initialization.

samples.source: 语音闭环里任何一段改成异步，都要重新定义首段可播的测量点。
samples.reference: If any stage of the speech loop becomes asynchronous, redefine where time to first playable segment is measured.
samples.hypothesis: In any segment within the voice closed loop that is changed to asynchronous, the initial playable measurement point must be redefined.

samples.source: 缓冲区的目标水位应当随网络抖动的历史分布自适应调整。
samples.reference: A buffer's target watermark should adapt to the historical distribution of network jitter.
samples.hypothesis: The target water level of the buffer should be adaptively adjusted according to the historical distribution of network fluctuations.

samples.source: 分块处理的窗口重叠长度会影响频谱估计的稳定度。
samples.reference: The overlap length of chunked processing affects the stability of the spectrum estimate.
samples.hypothesis: The overlapping length of the window used for block processing affects the stability of the spectrum estimation.

samples.source: 背压在跨进程边界上会失真，需要显式传递等待原因而不是靠超时推断。
samples.reference: Backpressure loses fidelity across a process boundary, so pass the waiting reason explicitly rather than inferring it from timeouts.
samples.hypothesis: Backpressure on the cross-process boundary can cause distortion; it is necessary to explicitly pass the waiting reason instead of relying on timeout inference.

samples.source: 检查点切换要保留旧实例直到最后一个请求返回。
samples.reference: On a checkpoint switch, keep the old instance alive until the last request has returned.
samples.hypothesis: Checkpoint switching must retain the old instance until the last request is returned.

samples.source: 流水线的排队等待不计入推理耗时，否则延迟报表会被误读。
samples.reference: Queueing ahead of the pipeline must not count as inference time, or latency reports become misleading.
samples.hypothesis: Queue waiting at the assembly line is not counted as part of the reasoning time; otherwise, the delay report would be misinterpreted.

samples.source: 帧长为 25 毫秒、帧移为 10 毫秒时，一帧对应三个采样点窗口。
samples.reference: With a 25 ms frame length and a 10 ms frame shift, one frame spans three sample windows.
samples.hypothesis: When the frame rate is 25 milliseconds and the frame shift is 10 milliseconds, one frame corresponds to a three-sample-point window.

samples.source: 队列的等待上限必须有硬边界，超过平台表示范围会直接抛错。
samples.reference: A queue wait limit needs a hard ceiling; past the platform's representable range it raises instead of waiting.
samples.hypothesis: The queue's waiting limit must have a hard boundary; exceeding the platform's range will directly throw an error.

samples.source: 推理阶段的批大小上限要与显存水位联动，固定值在共享机器上不稳。
samples.reference: The inference batch cap should follow the memory watermark; a fixed value is unstable on shared machines.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum batch size during the inference phase must be linked to the VRAM level; a fixed value is unstable on shared machines.

samples.source: 解码器输出的时间戳精度到毫秒即可，字幕文件不需要厘秒。
samples.reference: Millisecond timestamps from the decoder are enough; subtitle files do not need centiseconds.
samples.hypothesis: The decoder's timestamp precision should be down to milliseconds; subtitle files do not require sub-millisecond accuracy.

samples.source: 流式识别的部分结果要标注是否可回退，供下游决定是否上屏。
samples.reference: Partial results from streaming recognition should say whether they can be revised, so downstream can decide to show them.
samples.hypothesis: Some of the streamed recognition results need to be marked as reversible, so that the downstream system can decide whether to display them.

samples.source: 语音分段结果与说话人分离结果合并时，段边界可能不一致需要仲裁。
samples.reference: Merging voice segmentation with speaker diarization can disagree on boundaries and needs arbitration.
samples.hypothesis: When merging the voice segment results with the speaker identification results, the segment boundaries may be inconsistent, requiring arbitration.

samples.source: 运行时退出前要打印各阶段缓冲剩余量，便于事后判断是否丢数据。
samples.reference: On shutdown the runtime should print what each buffer still holds, to tell later whether data was dropped.
samples.hypothesis: Before exiting during runtime, print the remaining buffer for each stage to facilitate post-processing judgment on whether data was lost.

samples.source: 队列超时后仍要继续消费，避免恢复瞬间被积压请求淹没。
samples.reference: Keep draining after a queue timeout, so a flood of backlogged requests does not overwhelm the restart.
samples.hypothesis: Even after the queue timeout, continue processing to prevent being overwhelmed by a sudden surge of backlog requests.

samples.source: 流水线里共享的可变状态要用消息传递替代锁，否则阶段顺序一变就死锁。
samples.reference: Replace locks with message passing for shared mutable state in a pipeline; a stage reorder otherwise deadlocks.
samples.hypothesis: In assembly lines, shared mutable states should be replaced with message passing instead of locks, otherwise a deadlock will occur if the sequence of stages changes.

samples.source: 首包延迟与首段可播是两个量，不能混用同一个指标名。
samples.reference: Time to first packet and time to first playable segment are different measurements and must not share one metric name.
samples.hypothesis: The first package delay and the first segment's playtime are two separate metrics; the same indicator name cannot be used for both.

samples.source: 词元预算接近上限时，优先裁剪历史示例而不是术语表。
samples.reference: Near the token budget, trim the few-shot examples before the terminology list.
samples.hypothesis: When the character budget is approaching the limit, prioritize trimming historical examples over the terminology list.

samples.source: 分块下载的音频要先做采样率一致性校验再送入识别。
samples.reference: Chunk-downloaded audio needs a sample-rate consistency check before recognition.
samples.hypothesis: Audio files downloaded in chunks must first undergo sample rate consistency verification before being sent to the recognition system.

samples.source: 缓冲区预取过多会让最后一个语段等待时间变长。
samples.reference: Over-prefetching in the buffer lengthens how long the final speech segment waits.
samples.hypothesis: Excessive buffer prefetching will increase the waiting time for the last segment.

samples.source: 流式传输的序号回绕要在协议层定义清楚，不能靠实现默契。
samples.reference: Sequence wrap-around in streaming transport must be defined by the protocol, not left to implementation habit.
samples.hypothesis: The sequence numbers for streaming transmission must be clearly defined at the protocol layer, not relying on tacit understanding between implementations.

samples.source: 解码器遇到损坏帧时应当输出静音帧并记录原因，而不是直接抛异常。
samples.reference: On a corrupt frame the decoder should emit silence and record the reason rather than raising.
samples.hypothesis: When encountering a damaged frame, the decoder should output a silent frame and record the reason, rather than directly throwing an exception.

samples.source: 推理结果缓存以语言对与领域共同定键，跨领域复用会错配语境。
samples.reference: The inference result cache is keyed by language pair and domain together; reusing across domains mismatches context.
samples.hypothesis: The reasoning result cache is keyed by language and domain; cross-domain reuse may lead to contextual misalignment.

samples.source: 流水线的每一段都要能单独降级，而不是整体失败。
samples.reference: Each stage of the pipeline needs its own degradation path instead of failing as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Each section of the assembly line should be able to fail independently without causing the entire system to fail.

samples.source: 运行时指标里排队时长与处理时长分开统计，运维才知道该扩容哪一段。
samples.reference: Separate queueing time from processing time in runtime metrics so operators know which stage to scale.
samples.hypothesis: During runtime, queue duration and processing time are tracked separately so that operations teams can identify which section needs scaling.

samples.source: 音频归一化要放在编码之前做，动态范围才不会被压缩吃掉。
samples.reference: Do audio normalization before encoding, or the dynamic range gets compressed away.
samples.hypothesis: Audio normalization should be done before encoding to prevent the dynamic range from being consumed by compression.

samples.source: 转码任务按片段粒度断点续跑，失败时不必从头重来。
samples.reference: Transcoding jobs resume per segment, so a failure does not restart the whole file.
samples.hypothesis: The transcoding task is broken down into fragments for continuous execution, so failures do not require starting over from the beginning.

samples.source: 码率控制选择恒定质量时，关键帧间隔会随之浮动而非固定。
samples.reference: Constant-quality rate control lets the keyframe interval float instead of staying fixed.
samples.hypothesis: When choosing constant bitrate control, the key frame interval will fluctuate accordingly rather than being fixed.

samples.source: 容器格式的时间戳基准是媒体时间，换算成墙钟需要轨道起始偏移。
samples.reference: A container format stamps media time, so wall-clock conversion needs the track's start offset.
samples.hypothesis: The container format timestamp baseline is media time, which requires an orbital start offset to convert into wall clock time.

samples.source: 复用器要求两条轨道的采样点对齐，否则会插入填充包。
samples.reference: The multiplexer demands sample-aligned tracks, or it inserts filler packets.
samples.hypothesis: The reuser requires the sampling points of the two tracks to be aligned; otherwise, a fill packet will be inserted.

samples.source: 解码器的错误隐藏强度是可配置项，过高会让损坏音频听起来平滑但失真。
samples.reference: Decoder error concealment is configurable; too much makes damaged audio smooth but wrong.
samples.hypothesis: The error hiding intensity of the decoder is a configurable parameter. An excessively high value will make damaged audio sound smooth but distorted.

samples.source: 图像组长度与随机接入点共同决定快进快退的响应速度。
samples.reference: The group of pictures length and the random access points decide how responsive seeking is.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the image group, together with the random access point, determines the response speed for fast-forwarding and fast-reverse.

samples.source: 帧间预测依赖参考帧顺序，丢帧后必须请求新的同步点。
samples.reference: Inter-frame prediction depends on reference order, so a lost frame must trigger a fresh sync point.
samples.hypothesis: Frame-interpolation prediction depends on the order of reference frames; after a frame drop, a new synchronization point must be requested.

samples.source: 量化参数越高压缩率越高，但文字边缘的块效应会先进入可见范围。
samples.reference: A higher quantization parameter compresses more, but blocking artifacts on text edges become visible first.
samples.hypothesis: The higher the quantization parameters, the higher the compression rate, but the block effect at the edges of the text will become visible first.

samples.source: 熵编码的上下文表要在流开始时重置，跨片段复用会造成漂移。
samples.reference: The entropy coding context table must reset at stream start; reusing it across segments causes drift.
samples.hypothesis: The context table for entropy coding must be reset at the beginning of the stream; reuse across segments will cause drift.

samples.source: 转码链路里保持原始采样点总数不变，重采样只在显式请求时启用。
samples.reference: A transcoding chain keeps the original sample count unless resampling is explicitly requested.
samples.hypothesis: In the transcode pipeline, the total number of original sampling points remains unchanged. Resampling is enabled only when explicitly requested.

samples.source: 无损压缩只保证比特一致，不保证人耳听到的主观质量提升。
samples.reference: Lossless compression guarantees identical bits, not a better subjective quality.
samples.hypothesis: Lossless compression only ensures that the bitstream remains identical; it does not guarantee an improvement in subjective quality as perceived by the human ear.

samples.source: 有损压缩在低码率下会优先牺牲高频细节而非语音基频。
samples.reference: At low bitrate, lossy compression sacrifices high-frequency detail before the voice fundamental.
samples.hypothesis: Lossy compression at low bit rates prioritizes sacrificing high-frequency details over the fundamental frequency of speech.

samples.source: 解复用器遇到交错写入的轨道时要按解码顺序输出样本。
samples.reference: A demuxer must emit samples in decode order when tracks were interleaved on write.
samples.hypothesis: When encountering interleaved writes, the demultiplexer must output samples in the decoding order.

samples.source: 比特率探测窗口过短会把静止画面误判成可以降到极低码率。
samples.reference: A bitrate estimation window that is too short mistakes a still frame for something expendable.
samples.hypothesis: A bitrate detection window that is too short will mistakenly identify static images as capable of being downsampled to a very low bitrate.

samples.source: 编解码器协商失败时必须落回双方共同支持的最低配置。
samples.reference: Negotiation between codecs must fall back to the lowest configuration both sides support.
samples.hypothesis: When codec negotiation fails, it must revert to the lowest configuration supported by both parties.

samples.source: 容器格式对轨道数量的限制会在多字幕语言时先撞上。
samples.reference: Container format limits on track count are hit first when many subtitle languages are bundled.
samples.hypothesis: Container format restrictions on the number of tracks will be the first thing to hit when using multiple subtitle languages.

samples.source: 关键帧间隔超过两秒时，直播场景的拖动预览会明显迟钝。
samples.reference: Keyframe intervals beyond two seconds make scrubbing previews sluggish in live scenarios.
samples.hypothesis: When the keyframe interval exceeds two seconds, the drag preview in the live stream scene becomes noticeably sluggish.

samples.source: 运动估计的搜索范围增大并不总能提升质量，却一定增加编码耗时。
samples.reference: Widening the motion estimation search rarely improves quality and always costs encoding time.
samples.hypothesis: Expanding the search range for motion estimation does not always improve quality, but it certainly increases encoding time.

samples.source: 帧内预测在静止画面上的收益高于帧间预测，但码率也随之上升。
samples.reference: Intra-frame prediction pays off on still imagery more than inter-frame, though the bitrate rises.
samples.hypothesis: Intra-frame prediction yields higher performance on still images, but the bit rate also increases accordingly.

samples.source: 编码器输出的容器头信息应当与素材真实声道数一致，不能沿用模板。
samples.reference: The container header an encoder writes must match the real channel count, not the template's.
samples.hypothesis: The container header information output by the encoder must match the actual number of channels in the material; a template cannot be reused.

samples.source: 转码前的媒体探针结果要落盘，事后核对声道与位深变化。
samples.reference: Save the probe result before transcoding, to check channel and bit-depth changes afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The pre-transcoding media probe results need to be saved on disk, and then the channel and bit depth changes should be verified.

samples.source: 多进程转码时每个进程独立持有缓冲，禁止共享帧缓冲内存。
samples.reference: In multi-process transcoding each process owns its buffer; sharing frame buffer memory is forbidden.
samples.hypothesis: During multi-process transcoding, each process holds its own buffer independently; sharing frame buffer memory is prohibited.

samples.source: 解码顺序与显示顺序不同的轨道必须由容器显式记录偏移。
samples.reference: Tracks whose decode order differs from display order need an explicit container offset.
samples.hypothesis: Tracks with different decoding and display orders must have their offsets explicitly recorded by the container.

samples.source: 码率控制对旁白静音段的分配应当低于同期对白，而非均分。
samples.reference: Rate control should allocate less to narration silence than to the speech in the same passage.
samples.hypothesis: The bit rate allocation for the silent narration segments should be lower than for the simultaneous dialogue, rather than evenly distributed.

samples.source: 熵解码错误在关键帧之后才可恢复，静音期不能替代同步点。
samples.reference: Entropy decoding errors recover only at a keyframe; silence is not a sync point.
samples.hypothesis: Entropy decoding errors can only be recovered after the keyframes; the silent period cannot replace the synchronization point.

samples.source: GOP 首帧必须是可独立解码帧，否则切片工具会在段首花屏。
samples.reference: The first frame of a group of pictures must be independently decodable, or segmenting tools show corruption.
samples.hypothesis: The first frame of the GOP must be independently decodable; otherwise, the slicing tool will cause screen flickering at the start of the segment.

samples.source: 容器格式的元数据字段长度限制会影响双语字幕的轨道命名。
samples.reference: A container format's metadata length limits affect how bilingual subtitle tracks are named.
samples.hypothesis: The length limit for metadata fields in container formats can affect the naming of bilingual subtitle tracks.

samples.source: 编码器对字幕轨只做透传时，也要保留原始时间轴精度。
samples.reference: Pass-through of a subtitle track must still preserve the original timeline precision.
samples.hypothesis: When the encoder only performs transparent transmission of the subtitle track, the original time axis precision must still be preserved.

samples.source: 转码并发改多了会让磁盘随机写成为瓶颈，而非 CPU。
samples.reference: Too much transcoding concurrency makes random disk writes the bottleneck rather than the CPU.
samples.hypothesis: Too much transcoding and reconfiguration will cause the disk to be randomly written, becoming a bottleneck rather than the CPU.

samples.source: 双语字幕的每一行都要各自满足阅读速度上限，不能只看中文一行。
samples.reference: Each line of a bilingual subtitle has to meet the reading-speed bound on its own, not just the Chinese one.
samples.hypothesis: Each line of the bilingual subtitles must meet its own reading speed limit; you can't just look at the Chinese line.

samples.source: 硬字幕烧进画面后只能靠重新编码修改，软字幕可以随时替换轨道。
samples.reference: Hard subtitles can only be changed by re-encoding, while soft subtitles let you swap the track at any time.
samples.hypothesis: Hard subtitles can only be modified by re-encoding after they are burned into the screen, while soft subtitles can be replaced on the track at any time.

samples.source: 字幕轨的字符编码要在容器里显式声明，否则播放器会按本地默认码页猜。
samples.reference: The subtitle track's encoding must be declared in the container, or the player guesses from the local code page.
samples.hypothesis: The character encoding for the subtitle track must be explicitly declared in the container, otherwise the player will guess it based on the local default code page.

samples.source: 配音替换的是音轨而不是时长，压缩时长会破坏声画同步。
samples.reference: Dubbing replaces the audio track, not the duration; squeezing the duration breaks audio-video sync.
samples.hypothesis: Voiceover replacement affects the audio track, not the duration. Compressing the duration will break the audio-visual synchronization.

samples.source: 旁白的语速通常低于对白，配音时不能沿用同一套时间轴策略。
samples.reference: Narration is slower paced than dialogue, so dubbing cannot reuse the same timeline strategy.
samples.hypothesis: The pace of narration is generally slower than dialogue, so the same timing strategy cannot be used for voiceover.

samples.source: 对口型调整只能在帧级别微调，超过两帧就会看出违和。
samples.reference: Lip sync adjustment works only within a couple of frames; beyond that the mismatch becomes visible.
samples.hypothesis: Lip-sync adjustments can only be fine-tuned at the frame level; any change beyond two frames will make the result look off.

samples.source: 字幕时序的漂移通常累积在段落边界，而不是均匀分布在每行。
samples.reference: Subtitle timing drift accumulates at paragraph boundaries rather than spreading evenly across lines.
samples.hypothesis: Subsequent drift in the subtitle sequence typically accumulates at paragraph boundaries rather than being evenly distributed across each line.

samples.source: 字幕对齐要先按语音分段切点，再把文字映射到段边界。
samples.reference: Subtitle alignment should cut points by voice segmentation first, then map text onto those boundaries.
samples.hypothesis: For subtitle alignment, first segment the audio into points, then map the text to the boundaries of those segments.

samples.source: 分段计时要以素材的时间轴为基准，转码后不能假设毫秒值不变。
samples.reference: Segment timing must be based on the media timeline; do not assume millisecond values survive transcoding.
samples.hypothesis: Segmented timing must be based on the source material's timeline; after transcoding, the millisecond values cannot be assumed to remain unchanged.

samples.source: 字幕文件导入时若带字节顺序标记，要识别并剥除，否则首行字幕会带上不可见字符。
samples.reference: Detect and strip a byte order mark on subtitle import, or the first line carries an invisible character.
samples.hypothesis: When importing subtitle files, if byte order marks are present, they must be identified and stripped. Otherwise, the first line of subtitles will contain invisible characters.

samples.source: 配音与对口型的验收标准不同，前者听语音替换，后者看画面同步。
samples.reference: Dubbing and lip sync have different acceptance criteria: one is judged by the replaced voice, the other by the picture.
samples.hypothesis: The acceptance criteria for voice dubbing and lip-syncing are different. The former involves replacing audio, while the latter requires synchronizing with the visual content.

samples.source: 多语种字幕发布时，字幕轨语言要用语言代码而不是显示名。
samples.reference: Multi-language subtitle releases should key subtitle tracks by language code, not display name.
samples.hypothesis: When publishing multilingual subtitles, the subtitle track's language must be specified using language codes rather than names.

samples.source: 字幕行的换行位置要在渲染端决定，导出选项与之解耦。
samples.reference: Line breaking for subtitles belongs to the renderer, decoupled from export options.
samples.hypothesis: The line break position for the subtitle row should be determined by the rendering side, and the export options should be decoupled from it.

samples.source: 时间轴面板要区分视频帧号与音频采样点号，两者换算依赖帧率与采样率。
samples.reference: A timeline panel must separate video frame numbers from audio sample indices; conversion depends on frame rate and sample rate.
samples.hypothesis: The timeline panel needs to distinguish between video frame numbers and audio sample points. The conversion between the two depends on the frame rate and sample rate.

samples.source: 配音音轨的响度归一化目标要与原对白一致，否则切换时音量跳变。
samples.reference: The loudness target of a dubbed audio track must match the original or the level jumps when switching.
samples.hypothesis: The volume normalization target for the voice track must match the original dialogue; otherwise, there will be a volume jump during transitions.

samples.source: 字幕时序在变速播放下需要重新映射，倍速不是简单缩放时间戳。
samples.reference: Subtitle timing needs remapping under variable playback speed; scaling timestamps is not enough.
samples.hypothesis: The subtitle sequence needs to be remapped during variable-speed playback; playback speed is not simply a simple scaling of timestamps.

samples.source: 导出为 SRT 时时间戳精确到毫秒即可，ASS 需要到厘秒。
samples.reference: Export to SRT needs millisecond timestamps while ASS needs centiseconds.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting to SRT, the timestamp should be precise to the millisecond. For ASS, it needs to be accurate to the hundredth of a second.

samples.source: 预览窗口按软字幕渲染，让用户能开关字幕轨。
samples.reference: The preview renders soft subtitles so users can toggle the subtitle track.
samples.hypothesis: The preview window renders according to the soft subtitles, allowing users to switch subtitle tracks.

samples.source: 剪辑导出时若只改时间轴不改内容，重新封装就够，不要引入不必要的二压。
samples.reference: Re-muxing is enough when only the timeline changes; do not add an unnecessary second lossy compression pass.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting, if only the timeline is modified without changing the content, re-packaging is sufficient; avoid unnecessary re-encoding.

samples.source: 配音项目的交付要同时给音轨与双语字幕，缺一项就无法复核。
samples.reference: A dubbing delivery needs both the audio track and bilingual subtitles, or the work cannot be reviewed.
samples.hypothesis: For the voiceover project, both the audio track and bilingual subtitles must be delivered simultaneously; if either is missing, it cannot be reviewed.

samples.source: 字幕断句要避开词中间，中文按语段、拉丁文按词边界处理。
samples.reference: Subtitle line breaking must avoid cutting inside words: Chinese by speech segment, Latin scripts by word boundary.
samples.hypothesis: The subtitles should avoid breaking words in the middle. Chinese should be processed by segmenting into phrases, while Latin should be processed by segmenting into words.

samples.source: 音轨对齐检查可以在无配音情况下先做，不必等全部素材到位。
samples.reference: Timeline alignment checks can run before dubbing, without waiting for all assets.
samples.hypothesis: The audio track alignment check can be done first without any voiceover; you don't need to wait for all the materials to be ready.

samples.source: 台词删改会移动后续时间轴，需要整段重排而不是逐行挪。
samples.reference: Cutting a line shifts every later timestamp, so reflow the whole block rather than nudging rows.
samples.hypothesis: Dialogue edits will shift the subsequent timeline; the entire segment needs to be rearranged, not just individual lines moved.

samples.source: 配音演员的分段录音要保留采样率与位深一致，避免二次重采样。
samples.reference: Dubbing sessions must keep a consistent sample rate and bit depth to avoid a second resampling.
samples.hypothesis: The segmented recording of a voice actor must maintain the same sample rate and bit depth to avoid secondary resampling.

samples.source: 字幕轨的最大字符数应按目标语言宽度实测，不按中文经验值套。
samples.reference: The maximum characters per subtitle line should be measured for the target language's width, not copied from Chinese habits.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum character count for the subtitle track should be determined by the actual width of the target language, not based on Chinese experience values.

samples.source: 声画同步的容忍阈值要按素材类型定，会议录像与动画并不一样。
samples.reference: The audio-video sync tolerance depends on the material; conference recordings and animation differ.
samples.hypothesis: The tolerance threshold for audio-visual synchronization depends on the type of material; conference recordings are different from animations.

samples.source: 字幕的标点恢复要在分段之后做，跨段标点会错挂到相邻行。
samples.reference: Run punctuation restoration after segmentation, or punctuation crosses into neighbouring lines.
samples.hypothesis: The punctuation in the subtitles should be restored after segmenting; punctuation across segments will be incorrectly attached to adjacent lines.

samples.source: 旁白与对白混在同一音轨时，配音替换需要按语段定位。
samples.reference: When narration and dialogue share one audio track, dubbing replacement must locate speech segments first.
samples.hypothesis: When narration and dialogue are on the same audio track, voice replacement must be based on segment positioning.

samples.source: 导出前比对采样率、声道与位深三项，不匹配就提示并拒绝静默重采样。
samples.reference: Compare sample rate, channel count and bit depth before export, and refuse a silent resample when they differ.
samples.hypothesis: Before exporting, compare sample rate, channels, and bit depth. If there are any mismatches, indicate them and reject silent resampling.

samples.source: 字幕时序在缺帧素材上要按有效帧长插值，不能假设恒定帧率。
samples.reference: Subtitle timing on material with dropped frames must interpolate by real frame durations, not a constant rate.
samples.hypothesis: For subtitle timing, when there are missing frames, interpolation must be performed based on the effective frame length; a constant frame rate cannot be assumed.

samples.source: 多角色播客的本地化要先做说话人分离，再按角色分配合成音色。
samples.reference: Multi-speaker podcast localization needs speaker diarization first, then timbre assignment per role.
samples.hypothesis: For a multi-character podcast, you must first separate the speakers and then combine them according to the characters' voices.

samples.source: 配音的口型参考帧应在解码后取，编码前的帧序列不可靠。
samples.reference: Use decoded frames as the lip-sync reference; pre-encode frame order is unreliable.
samples.hypothesis: The lip-sync reference frames should be obtained after decoding; the frame sequence before encoding is unreliable.

samples.source: 字幕轨嵌套富文本时，容器格式对标签白名单要写清。
samples.reference: When a subtitle track carries rich text, spell out the container's tag whitelist.
samples.hypothesis: When nesting subtitle tracks with rich text, clearly specify the white list for container formats and tags.

samples.source: 把内嵌字幕转成软字幕需要光学字符识别，质量会低于原始文本。
samples.reference: Converting hard subtitles into soft ones needs optical recognition, and quality drops below authored text.
samples.hypothesis: Embedded subtitles require optical character recognition, and their quality will be lower than the original text.

samples.source: 时长压缩到 95% 会累积成半秒偏移，长素材必须分段校正。
samples.reference: Squeezing duration to 95 percent accumulates into a half-second offset; long material needs segment-wise correction.
samples.hypothesis: Compressing duration to 95% will accumulate a half-second offset; long materials must be corrected in segments.

samples.source: 配音交付要附时间轴文件与音轨两份产物，命名规则事先约定。
samples.reference: Dubbing delivery ships two artefacts, a timeline file and an audio track, with naming agreed in advance.
samples.hypothesis: The voiceover delivery must include two files: a timeline file and an audio track, with naming conventions agreed upon in advance.

samples.source: 字幕行长度与每屏行数共同决定阅读速度上限。
samples.reference: Line length and lines per screen together bound the readable speed of subtitles.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the subtitle line and the number of lines per screen together determine the upper limit of reading speed.

samples.source: 同一素材的多语种字幕应共享分段结果，避免各自漂移。
samples.reference: Subtitle tracks in several languages should share one segmentation result to avoid drifting apart.
samples.hypothesis: Multilingual subtitles for the same material should share the same segmenting results to avoid drifting.

samples.source: 时间轴导出要显式声明参考是媒体时间还是墙钟时间。
samples.reference: Timeline export must state whether it references media time or wall-clock time.
samples.hypothesis: The time axis export needs to explicitly state whether it refers to media time or wall clock time.

samples.source: 配音的呼吸声保留与否要与原声一致，过度降噪会显得虚假。
samples.reference: Keep or remove dubbing breathes consistently with the source; over-cleaning sounds artificial.
samples.hypothesis: Whether to retain the breathing sound in the dubbing should be consistent with the original voice; excessive noise reduction will make it sound artificial.

samples.source: 字幕对齐失败时要报出对不上的语段编号，方便人工介入。
samples.reference: On alignment failure, report the speech segment ids that disagree so a human can step in.
samples.hypothesis: When subtitle alignment fails, report the mismatched segment numbers for manual intervention.

samples.source: 字幕轨与视频轨的起始偏移要各自记录，合并后无法反推。
samples.reference: Record the start offsets of subtitle and video tracks separately; they cannot be recovered after muxing.
samples.hypothesis: The starting offset for the subtitle track and the video track must be recorded separately; after merging, it cannot be reversed.

samples.source: 变速与变调要分别声明，只调其一时听感会不一致。
samples.reference: Declare speed and pitch changes separately; changing one alone sounds inconsistent.
samples.hypothesis: Acceleration and pitch changes must be declared separately; adjusting only one will result in an inconsistent auditory experience.

samples.source: 对白密集的素材里，字幕分段应以停顿而不是标点为主判据。
samples.reference: In dialogue-dense material, break subtitles on pauses rather than punctuation.
samples.hypothesis: In dialogue-heavy materials, subtitle segmentation should primarily be based on pauses rather than punctuation.

samples.source: 音轨替换后重新混流时，要保留原轨的语言标签与默认轨标记。
samples.reference: After swapping an audio track, preserve its language tag and default-track flag when re-muxing.
samples.hypothesis: When remixing after replacing the audio track, preserve the language tag and default track marker of the original track.

samples.source: 字幕时序校正要以可懂度为准，不为齐帧牺牲断句。
samples.reference: Let intelligibility rule subtitle timing fixes rather than aligning to frames.
samples.hypothesis: Subsequent timing correction should prioritize comprehensibility; it shouldn't sacrifice sentence breaks for frame alignment.

samples.source: 配音时长超出画面时，优先调整语速而不是删内容。
samples.reference: When a dubbing runs long against the picture, adjust pacing before cutting content.
samples.hypothesis: When the voiceover duration exceeds the screen duration, prioritize adjusting the speaking speed over deleting content.

samples.source: 把双语字幕上下排布会让每屏行数翻倍，需下调停留时间。
samples.reference: Stacking bilingual subtitles doubles lines per screen, so dwell time must shrink.
samples.hypothesis: Arranging the bilingual subtitles vertically will double the number of lines per screen, requiring a reduction in the dwell time.

samples.source: 字幕文件的时间戳若早于视频起始偏移，播放器会丢弃该行。
samples.reference: The player drops subtitle lines whose timestamps precede the video's start offset.
samples.hypothesis: If the timestamp in the subtitle file is earlier than the video's start offset, the player will discard that line.

samples.source: 导出前检查相邻字幕重叠，重叠会让阅读者不知读哪一行。
samples.reference: Check for overlapping subtitles before export; overlap leaves the reader unsure which line to read.
samples.hypothesis: Before exporting, check for adjacent subtitle overlaps. Overlaps can confuse readers about which line to read.

samples.source: 配音演员的分段间隔要留静音余量，便于后期对齐。
samples.reference: Leave silence padding between dubbing takes to make later alignment possible.
samples.hypothesis: The segments of voice actors should leave some silence space to facilitate alignment in post-production.

samples.source: 长视频的字幕分段建议按语义段落而不是固定秒数切。
samples.reference: Split subtitles for long video by semantic paragraphs rather than fixed seconds.
samples.hypothesis: Suggested subtitles for long videos should be segmented by semantic paragraphs rather than fixed seconds.

samples.source: 字幕时序导出为帧率非整数素材时，必须用时间基而不是帧计数。
samples.reference: For non-integer frame rates, export subtitle timing in a timebase instead of frame counts.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting the subtitle timeline to footage with a non-integer frame rate, the time base must be used instead of frame counting.

samples.source: 音轨的响度目标要在混流前定，混完再压会牵连对白。
samples.reference: Set the loudness target before muxing; compressing afterwards also affects dialogue.
samples.hypothesis: The target volume of the audio track should be set before the mix; compressing after mixing will affect the dialogue.

samples.source: 字幕断行遇到缩写与专有名词要有保护规则，避免误断。
samples.reference: Line breaking needs protection rules for abbreviations and proper names.
samples.hypothesis: When a subtitle line break occurs, abbreviations and proper nouns must be protected to prevent incorrect segmentation.

samples.source: 对口型素材若帧率不一致，要先统一到时间轴基准。
samples.reference: Normalize differing frame rates onto one timeline before any lip-sync work.
samples.hypothesis: If the frame rates of lip-sync materials are inconsistent, they must first be aligned to a common timeline baseline.

samples.source: 字幕的省略号与破折号在语音合成里需要单独停顿规则。
samples.reference: Ellipses and dashes in subtitles need their own pause rules for speech synthesis.
samples.hypothesis: The ellipses and dashes in subtitles require separate pauses in voice synthesis.

samples.source: 配音质检要按语段回放，整片一次过会漏掉局部不同步。
samples.reference: Review dubbing speech segment by segment; one pass over the whole show misses local desync.
samples.hypothesis: Voiceover quality inspection should be done by replaying each segment. If the entire track passes the test in one go, any local synchronization issues will be missed.

samples.source: 多语言交付里，字幕文件命名要含语言代码与来源标记。
samples.reference: In multilingual delivery, subtitle filenames carry the language code and provenance.
samples.hypothesis: In multilingual delivery, subtitle files must include the language code and source marker.

samples.source: 时间轴导出要包含轨道偏移与有效帧率两项元数据。
samples.reference: Timeline export must include track offsets and the effective frame rate.
samples.hypothesis: The time axis export must include two metadata items: track offset and effective frame rate.

samples.source: 字幕行的停留时长下限由字数决定，不由切换节奏决定。
samples.reference: A subtitle line's minimum dwell time is set by its length, not by cut rhythm.
samples.hypothesis: The minimum duration for a subtitle line is determined by the number of characters, not by the switching rhythm.

samples.source: 旁白与配乐同轨时，配音替换需要额外的分离步骤。
samples.reference: When narration shares a track with music, dubbing needs an extra separation step.
samples.hypothesis: When the narration and background music are on the same track, replacing the voice-over requires an additional separation step.

samples.source: 字幕轨的字符集要在导出日志里记录，供现场排障。
samples.reference: Record the subtitle track's character set in the export log for field debugging.
samples.hypothesis: The character set of the subtitle track must be recorded in the export log for on-site troubleshooting.

samples.source: 声画同步测量要用人耳可辨的事件点，例如掌声与敲击。
samples.reference: Measure audio-video sync on audible events such as claps and strikes.
samples.hypothesis: For sound and image synchronization measurement, event points that are perceptible to the human ear are required, such as applause and tapping.

samples.source: 字幕对齐的人工抽检要覆盖首尾与中途，长素材中段最容易漂。
samples.reference: Spot-check subtitle alignment at the start, middle and end; the middle drifts most.
samples.hypothesis: Manual alignment checks for subtitles must cover the beginning, end, and middle parts, as the middle section of long materials is most prone to drifting.

samples.source: 配音要按目标语言重排断句，直译长度常常超出画面。
samples.reference: Dubbing must re-break lines for the target language; literal length usually exceeds the picture.
samples.hypothesis: The dubbing needs to restructure sentence breaks according to the target language; direct translation often exceeds the visual length.

samples.source: 字幕时序在丢帧素材上要记录丢帧位置，否则校正无据。
samples.reference: Log dropped-frame positions on subtitle timelines, or corrections have no basis.
samples.hypothesis: For frame loss footage, the subtitle sequence must record the frame loss position; otherwise, correction will be without a basis.

samples.source: 多轨合并时默认轨与强制轨标记要显式写入，不靠播放器猜。
samples.reference: Write default and forced track flags explicitly when merging tracks.
samples.hypothesis: When multiple tracks are merged, the default track and forced track markers must be explicitly written; they cannot be inferred by the player.

samples.source: 导出双语字幕时，两种语言的停留时长要共同满足阅读速度约束。
samples.reference: When exporting bilingual subtitles, dwell time must satisfy one reading-speed bound for both languages.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting bilingual subtitles, the duration of both languages must jointly meet the reading speed constraint.

samples.source: 缓冲不足会让字幕渲染出现整行闪烁，与内容无关。
samples.reference: Underrun in the buffer makes whole subtitle lines flicker, independent of content.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient buffering will cause entire lines of subtitles to flicker, regardless of the content.

samples.source: 分段计时表要能导出为对照清单，供配音现场按行取用。
samples.reference: Export the segment timing sheet as a checklist dubbing sessions can follow line by line.
samples.hypothesis: The segmented timing table should be exportable as a reference list for voice actors to use line by line during recording.

samples.source: 时间轴上的静默段也要保留编号，删除会造成后续错位。
samples.reference: Keep numbering for silent spans on the timeline; deleting one shifts everything after it.
samples.hypothesis: Silent segments on the timeline must also be numbered; deleting them will cause misalignment later on.

samples.source: 音轨替换要同步替换时长元数据，只换负载会留下错长度。
samples.reference: Replacing an audio track must update its duration metadata, not just the payload.
samples.hypothesis: When replacing an audio track, the duration metadata must also be replaced synchronously; only replacing the load will leave the duration incorrect.

samples.source: 缓存命中率高不等于翻译质量好，缓存只说明这句话以前见过。
samples.reference: A high cache hit rate does not mean good translation quality; it only means the sentence was seen before.
samples.hypothesis: High cache hit rate does not mean good translation quality; the cache only indicates that this sentence has been seen before.

samples.source: 这里的缓存指的是音频帧缓存，不要译成网页缓存。
samples.reference: The cache here is the audio frame cache, not a web cache.
samples.hypothesis: The cache here refers to an audio frame cache, not a web page cache.

samples.source: 预取缓存开太大时，最后一个语段的等待时间反而变长。
samples.reference: An over-large prefetch cache lengthens how long the last speech segment waits.
samples.hypothesis: When the pre-picked cache is too large, the waiting time for the last paragraph actually increases.

samples.source: 磁盘缓存在断电后仍然有效，所以失效策略要写清版本标识。
samples.reference: A disk cache survives power loss, so its invalidation policy needs a version tag.
samples.hypothesis: Disk caching remains valid after power failure, so the invalidation strategy must clearly specify the version identifier.

samples.source: 缓存键必须含语言对与领域，否则跨领域复用会错配语境。
samples.reference: A cache key must include the language pair and domain, or cross-domain reuse mismatches context.
samples.hypothesis: Cache keys must include the language pair and domain; otherwise, reuse across domains will lead to contextual misalignment.

samples.source: 编解码器升级后旧码流仍能解码，兼容矩阵要写进发布说明。
samples.reference: After a codec upgrade old streams still decode, and the compatibility matrix belongs in the release notes.
samples.hypothesis: After the encoder/decoder upgrade, the old stream format remains decodable. The compatibility matrix must be included in the release notes.

samples.source: 这个文件需要软编解码器而不是系统自带的那个。
samples.reference: This file needs the software codec rather than the system one.
samples.hypothesis: This file requires a software encoder/decoder instead of the system's built-in one.

samples.source: 编解码器协商要看双方都支持的档位，不能只看自己声明的列表。
samples.reference: Codec negotiation must look at what both sides support, not just one's own advertised list.
samples.hypothesis: The codec negotiation depends on the supported levels agreed upon by both parties, not just the list declared by one side.

samples.source: 容器格式选错会让字幕轨被丢弃，即使视频轨看起来正常。
samples.reference: A wrong container format can drop the subtitle track even while video looks fine.
samples.hypothesis: Choosing the wrong container format will cause the subtitle track to be discarded, even if the video track appears normal.

samples.source: 同一段素材换容器格式封装后，时长元数据可能有几毫秒差异。
samples.reference: Re-muxing the same material into another container can shift duration metadata by a few milliseconds.
samples.hypothesis: After packaging the same content in different container formats, the duration metadata may have a difference of a few milliseconds.

samples.source: 混音要把对白、配乐与音效分轨处理，而不是在一条轨上叠。
samples.reference: A mix should treat dialogue, music and effects as separate stems rather than stacked on one track.
samples.hypothesis: Mixing involves separating the dialogue, background music, and sound effects into distinct tracks, rather than layering them on a single track.

samples.source: 混音后的响度目标要按交付平台要求设定，不是越响越好。
samples.reference: Set the loudness target of the mix to the delivery platform's requirement, not as loud as possible.
samples.hypothesis: The post-mixing loudness target should be set according to the delivery platform's requirements; it's not about being as loud as possible.

samples.source: 混音阶段保留头部空间，避免后期压缩再次抬升噪声。
samples.reference: Leave headroom during mixing so later compression does not lift the noise floor.
samples.hypothesis: During the mixing phase, preserve headroom to prevent the post-compression stage from further increasing noise.

samples.source: 分轨导出时每条轨的起始时间必须一致，否则合回会错位。
samples.reference: Exported stems must share one start time, or reassembling them misaligns.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting tracks, the start time of each track must be consistent; otherwise, the merged file will be misaligned.

samples.source: 干声里残留的伴奏会被识别成语音，导致转写出现幻听内容。
samples.reference: Accompaniment left in the dry vocal is recognised as speech and invents transcript content.
samples.hypothesis: The accompaniment remaining in the dry voice will be recognized as speech, leading to auditory hallucinations during transcription.

samples.source: 配音的干声要单独留档，混音之后就无法再分离。
samples.reference: Keep the dubbing dry vocal archived on its own; after the mix it can no longer be separated.
samples.hypothesis: The dry voice of the dubbing needs to be saved separately, as it cannot be separated after mixing.

samples.source: 音轨表里的声道映射要按容器写，不按播放器显示顺序。
samples.reference: Map channels in the track table according to the container, not the player's display order.
samples.hypothesis: The channel mapping in the audio track table must be written according to the container, not the order displayed by the player.

samples.source: 路由规则改一次就要重跑覆盖矩阵，否则报表描述的不是当前配置。
samples.reference: Rerun the coverage matrix after any change to the routing table, or the report describes a stale configuration.
samples.hypothesis: If the routing rules are changed, the coverage matrix must be regenerated, otherwise the report will not reflect the current configuration.

samples.source: 这里的路由指引擎选择路由，不是网络路由表。
samples.reference: The routing here means engine selection, not a network routing table.
samples.hypothesis: The route here refers to the engine selecting a path, not the network routing table.

samples.source: 视频片段切片要以关键帧为界，否则会解出花屏。
samples.reference: Video clip cuts must land on keyframes, or the result decodes as corrupted.
samples.hypothesis: Video clip slicing should be based on keyframes; otherwise, it will result in flickering.

samples.source: 切片工具对无关键帧的长图像组支持有限，需要先重编码。
samples.reference: Splitting tools handle long groups of pictures poorly without re-encoding first.
samples.hypothesis: The clip tool has limited support for long image sets without keyframes and requires re-encoding first.

samples.source: 表格数据作为字幕源时要防公式注入，导出侧也要转义。
samples.reference: Spreadsheet data used as subtitle source needs formula-injection guards on both sides.
samples.hypothesis: When using table data as subtitle sources, prevent formula injection, and also escape it during export.

samples.source: 表结构变更要向后兼容，旧素材没有新字段是常态。
samples.reference: Keep the table schema backward compatible; old assets without the new field are the norm.
samples.hypothesis: Table structure changes must be backward compatible; it's normal for old materials to lack new fields.

samples.source: 帧率是媒体属性不是剪辑属性，导出侧不要二次换算。
samples.reference: Frame rate is a media property, not an editing one; do not convert it twice on export.
samples.hypothesis: Frame rate is a media attribute, not an editing attribute. Do not perform secondary conversion during export.

samples.source: 模型的部分权重损坏时应整体拒绝加载，而不是静默补齐。
samples.reference: If part of the model weights are corrupt, refuse the checkpoint instead of silently filling in.
samples.hypothesis: When some weights of the model are damaged, the entire model should be rejected from loading instead of silently repairing them.

samples.source: 词表不匹配时子词切分会退化成逐字符，推理质量随之崩塌。
samples.reference: On a vocabulary mismatch, subword tokenisation degrades to per-character and quality collapses.
samples.hypothesis: When the vocabulary doesn't match, subword splitting degrades into character-by-character processing, leading to a collapse in reasoning quality.

samples.source: 流水线在队列满时给的是拒绝还是等待，必须是可观测的。
samples.reference: Whether the pipeline rejects or waits on a full queue has to be observable.
samples.hypothesis: When the production line queue is full, should it return a rejection or a wait? It must be observable.

samples.source: 队列策略变更会影响首包延迟，回归里要一起看。
samples.reference: A queue policy change moves time to first packet, so keep it in the same regression.
samples.hypothesis: The queue strategy change will affect the first packet delay; we'll review this together upon return.

samples.source: 缓冲与缓冲区的译法在中文里同形，英文要统一为 buffer。
samples.reference: Buffering and buffer both read the same in Chinese; keep one English word for them.
samples.hypothesis: The terms for buffer and buffer zone are homophones in Chinese, so in English they should be consistently translated as "buffer".

samples.source: 数据流与流式传输在文档里要区分，一个是内容一个是传输方式。
samples.reference: Separate the data stream from streaming transport in docs: one is content, the other is how it travels.
samples.hypothesis: Data streams and streaming transmission must be distinguished in the document; one refers to content, while the other refers to the method of transmission.

samples.source: 检查点是指模型权重还是任务断点，句子里要靠上下文消除歧义。
samples.reference: Say from context whether checkpoint means model weights or a resume point.
samples.hypothesis: Checkpoint refers to model weights or task checkpoints; context is needed to resolve ambiguity in the sentence.

samples.source: 流水线的段与语音分段段是两个概念，命名要分开。
samples.reference: A pipeline stage and a speech segment are different notions; name them apart.
samples.hypothesis: The segment of the assembly line and the segment of voice segmentation are two distinct concepts and should be named separately.

samples.source: 声道与通道在英文里是同一个词，所以中文界面必须按领域强制选一个。
samples.reference: Channel covers both senses in English, so the Chinese interface must pick one by domain instead of defaulting.
samples.hypothesis: The term "声道" (channel) and "通道" (channel) are the same in English, so the Chinese interface must force a selection based on the domain.

samples.source: 关键帧与首帧不是同一件事，预览逻辑要按可解码帧判断。
samples.reference: A keyframe is not the first frame; preview logic must decide on decodable frames.
samples.hypothesis: Keyframes and the first frame are not the same thing; the preview logic should be determined based on decodable frames.

samples.source: 词元与子词在计费与切分上口径不同，报表不能混用。
samples.reference: Tokens and subwords differ for billing and for segmentation; do not share one metric.
samples.hypothesis: The token and sub-token have different standards for billing and segmentation, so they cannot be used interchangeably in reports.

samples.source: 比特率与码率在文档里统一用一个词，避免读者以为两项指标。
samples.reference: Keep bitrate and rate control terminology distinct but consistent, or readers see two metrics.
samples.hypothesis: Bit rate and code rate are referred to by a single term in the document to avoid readers confusing the two metrics.

samples.source: 分块与批处理是两回事，分块是流式内的窗口。
samples.reference: Chunking is not batching; chunking is a window inside streaming, batching is a group of requests.
samples.hypothesis: Segmentation and batch processing are two different things. Segmentation refers to a window within a streaming process.

samples.source: 重采样与重新量化都要声明，混在一起会掩盖质量损失。
samples.reference: Declare resampling and requantisation separately, or one hides the other's damage.
samples.hypothesis: Resampling and requantization must both be declared; combining them will mask the quality loss.

samples.source: 编码器预设档位与质量参数冲突时应报错，不是静默取一个。
samples.reference: Error out when an encoder preset and an explicit quality flag conflict, rather than silently choosing one.
samples.hypothesis: An error should occur when the encoder's preset mode conflicts with quality parameters; it should not silently select one.

samples.source: 解码器在硬件与软件之间回退时，要记录回退原因。
samples.reference: Record why the decoder fell back from hardware to software.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoder performs a rollback between hardware and software, it must record the reason for the rollback.

samples.source: 容器与编解码器的能力列表不一致，以容器约束为准。
samples.reference: When container and codec capabilities disagree, the container's constraint wins.
samples.hypothesis: The capabilities of the container and the encoder/decoder are inconsistent; the container constraints shall take precedence.

samples.source: 混音轨数超过容器上限时，要先给可执行提示再失败。
samples.reference: Warn before failing when the mix exceeds the container's track limit.
samples.hypothesis: When the number of mix tracks exceeds the container's limit, a prompt should be given first before failing.

samples.source: 干声质量决定配音可懂度，伴奏残留的代价是转写错字。
samples.reference: Dry vocal quality drives dubbing intelligibility; leftover accompaniment shows up as transcript errors.
samples.hypothesis: Voice quality determines how intelligible the dubbing is; the cost of leftover background music is typos in the transcription.

samples.source: 表格导入的字幕时长若缺列，要按行报错而不是补默认值。
samples.reference: Report the row when a subtitle sheet lacks a duration column, instead of defaulting it.
samples.hypothesis: If the duration column is missing when importing a table, errors should be reported per row instead of using default values.

samples.source: 帧序号在跨段拼接后必须重排，否则解码顺序与显示顺序倒挂。
samples.reference: Renumber frames after concatenation, or decode order and display order invert.
samples.hypothesis: After cross-segment concatenation, the frame sequence must be reordered; otherwise, the decoding order will be reversed from the display order.

samples.source: 路由决策要能回读，只给结果不给路径无法排障。

samples.hypothesis: Routing decisions must be retrievable; providing only the result without the path makes troubleshooting impossible.

samples.source: 词表的领域覆盖决定子词切分好坏，通用词表在专名上会碎。
samples.reference: A vocabulary's domain coverage decides subword quality; a general one shreds proper nouns.
samples.hypothesis: The domain of the vocabulary determines the quality of subword segmentation; general vocabulary lists tend to fragment proper nouns.

samples.source: 缓存失效在跨版本场景要按语言对粒度，而不是全局清空。

samples.hypothesis: In cross-version scenarios, cache expiration should be handled by language granularity, not a global reset.

samples.source: 自动评测不能替代人工评测，窄域上指标与人工打分相关性明显下降。

samples.source: 抽样评测要按子领域分层，否则长尾问题看不见。
samples.reference: Sample evaluations must stratify by sub-domain, or the long tail stays invisible.
samples.hypothesis: Sampling evaluations should be stratified by sub-domain; otherwise, long-tail problems will remain undetected.

samples.source: 中文语音评测以字符错误率为主指标，词错误率依赖分词口径。
samples.reference: Chinese speech evaluation leans on character error rate, because word error rate depends on a tokenisation convention.
samples.hypothesis: Chinese voice evaluation primarily uses character error rate as the main indicator, while word error rate depends on the segmentation criteria.

samples.source: 对照实验只改一个变量，同时改注入策略与上限会让结果无法归因。
samples.reference: Change one variable per experiment; altering injection policy and its cap together makes results unattributable.
samples.hypothesis: The control experiment changes only one variable, while also altering the injection strategy and upper limit, which makes it impossible to attribute the results.

samples.source: 评测样本要覆盖短句、中句、长句三档，失败模式各不相同。
samples.reference: Evaluation samples should cover short, medium and long sentences; their failure modes differ.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation samples must cover short, medium, and long sentences, with distinct failure modes for each.

samples.source: 回归基线一旦发布就要固定种子与时间戳，便于复现。
samples.reference: Once a regression baseline is published, fix the seed and timestamp so it can be reproduced.
samples.hypothesis: Once the baseline is released, the seed and timestamp must be fixed to facilitate reproducibility.

samples.source: 统计显著性不等于实际显著，零点几个百分点要看是否影响体感。

samples.hypothesis: Statistical significance does not equate to practical significance. The difference of a few tenths of a percentage point should be assessed based on whether it affects the perceived experience.

samples.source: 负结论也要同样口径报告，不能只报成功的那一轮。

samples.hypothesis: The negative conclusion must also be reported with the same level of detail; you cannot only report the successful round.

samples.source: 评测重跑要限定范围参数，否则会把其他引擎的既有证据覆盖掉。
samples.reference: Scope a rerun explicitly, or it overwrites evidence belonging to other engines.
samples.hypothesis: Replicating the evaluation requires limiting the parameter scope, otherwise it will overwrite existing evidence from other engines.

samples.source: 分母里不能混入失败行，否则会把引擎故障报成质量下降。

samples.hypothesis: Failure rows must not be included in the denominator, otherwise the engine's failure will be mistaken for a quality decline.

samples.source: 同臂复采给出噪声地板，落在地板内的差值不足以归因。
samples.reference: Same-arm repeats give the noise floor; a delta inside it cannot be attributed.
samples.hypothesis: The same-arm re采 provides a noise floor, and the difference within this floor is insufficient to be attributed.

samples.source: 指标行要能追到一次可复现运行，含脚本、样本与时间。
samples.reference: Every metric row must trace to one reproducible run with script, samples and time.
samples.hypothesis: The indicator line must be able to be traced once with reproducible execution, including scripts, samples, and timestamps.

samples.source: 人工抽检的污染率要有实测来源，不能沿用旧一轮的估计。
samples.reference: Keep a measured source for spot-checked contamination rates instead of reusing an old estimate.
samples.hypothesis: The contamination rate from manual sampling must have actual measurement sources and cannot rely on the estimates from the previous round.

samples.source: 评测脚本要进版本控制，仓外的一次性脚本无人能复核。

samples.hypothesis: The evaluation script must be version-controlled; no one can review one-time scripts stored outside the repository.

samples.source: 配对比较要按同一批句子，不同窗口的均值差不是效果。
samples.reference: Pair on the same sentences; a difference between unlike windows is not an effect.
samples.hypothesis: The paired comparison should be based on the same set of sentences; the mean difference across different windows is not a valid effect.

samples.source: 留出集要真留出，参与过调优的样本不能当评测集。
samples.reference: Hold-out means held out; samples that took part in tuning cannot be the evaluation set.
samples.hypothesis: The samples that were part of the tuning process cannot be used as a test set.

samples.source: 报告要写清局限，分布差异不外推到未覆盖的领域。
samples.reference: State limitations plainly; do not extrapolate a distribution beyond the domains it covers.
samples.hypothesis: The report must clearly state the limitations, and distribution differences should not be extrapolated to un-covered areas.

samples.source: 每个对外数字都要有实测来源，估计值一律标注为估算。
samples.reference: Every published number needs a measured source; label estimates as estimates.
samples.hypothesis: Every external number must have a tested source; all estimates must be labeled as approximations.

samples.source: 同一指标的多次运行要区分身份，避免新跑覆盖旧证。

samples.hypothesis: For multiple runs of the same indicator, identities must be distinguished to prevent new runs from overwriting old records.

samples.source: 评测语料的许可要过门禁，不允许传染性许可进入产物。
samples.reference: Evaluation corpora must pass the license gate; no copyleft licence may enter the artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: Permission for the evaluation corpus must be approved through access control; contagious permissions are not allowed to enter the product.

samples.source: 子领域分组的边界要写进配置，不能靠人记住行号。
samples.reference: Record sub-domain group boundaries in config, not in someone's memory of line numbers.
samples.hypothesis: The boundaries of sub-domain groups must be specified in the configuration; they cannot be remembered by human memory.

samples.source: 自动分数的绝对值不适合作承诺，相对差与人工判断才可靠。
samples.reference: Absolute automatic scores make poor promises; relative deltas plus human review hold.
samples.hypothesis: The absolute value of automatic scores is not suitable for commitment; relative differences and manual judgment are more reliable.

samples.source: 抽样规模不足时报告要拒绝判定，而不是给出乐观数字。
samples.reference: Refuse to conclude under an insufficient sample rather than printing an optimistic number.
samples.hypothesis: When the sample size is insufficient, the report should reject the judgment instead of providing an optimistic figure.

samples.source: 评测脚本的失败要非零退出，静默通过会骗过后续流程。
samples.reference: Fail non-zero in evaluation scripts; a silent pass misleads everything downstream.
samples.hypothesis: A failed evaluation script must exit with a non-zero status; silent success will deceive subsequent processes.

samples.source: 回归集扩样时旧行的顺序不可改动，否则历史数字不再可比。
samples.reference: Never reorder existing rows when growing a regression set, or past numbers stop being comparable.
samples.hypothesis: When returning to the expanded sample, the order of the old rows must not be changed, otherwise the historical numbers will no longer be comparable.

samples.source: 指标口径变更要另立一次变更，不与数据扩充同批合入。
samples.reference: Land a metric-definition change in its own commit, not together with corpus growth.
samples.hypothesis: A change in the indicator scope requires a separate change entry and should not be combined with data expansion in the same batch.

samples.source: 评测环境要有前置声明，宿主服务在跑与否会改变结论。

samples.hypothesis: The evaluation environment requires a prior declaration; whether the host service is running or not will affect the results.

samples.source: 人工评测的标注规范要先写，事后统一会引入回看偏差。
samples.reference: Write the annotation guideline before human review, or hindsight biases the labels.
samples.hypothesis: The manually evaluated annotation guidelines must be established first, and review bias will be introduced afterward.

samples.source: 对照组与实验组必须同机同版本，跨机对比不成立。
samples.reference: Control and treatment need the same machine and build; cross-machine comparison is void.
samples.hypothesis: The control group and the experimental group must be on the same machine with the same version; cross-machine comparisons are invalid.

samples.source: 指标下降要先排除测量层，再怀疑模型能力。
samples.reference: Rule out the measurement layer before blaming the model when a metric drops.
samples.hypothesis: First, rule out measurement errors when the indicator drops, then question the model's capabilities.

samples.source: 可复现要求包含数据、脚本、时间与环境四项，缺一即不成立。
samples.reference: Reproducibility needs data, script, timestamp and environment; one missing voids it.
samples.hypothesis: The reproducibility requirement must include data, script, time, and environment; if any of these are missing, it does not meet the requirement.

samples.source: 评测结果入库前要校验自描述字段，缺身份的证据不可引用。
samples.reference: Verify self-describing fields before storing evidence; anonymous artefacts cannot be cited.
samples.hypothesis: Before adding the evaluation results to the database, the self-description field must be verified. Evidence lacking identity cannot be referenced.

samples.source: 统计区间要同时报置信区间与样本量，只报均值没有意义。

samples.hypothesis: For a statistical interval, both the confidence interval and sample size should be reported; reporting only the mean is meaningless.

samples.source: 边界样本要专挑易歧义词，随机抽样测不出领域敏感度。
samples.reference: Build boundary probes around ambiguous words; random sampling cannot measure domain sensitivity.
samples.hypothesis: Boundary samples must specifically target ambiguous terms; random sampling cannot measure domain sensitivity.

samples.source: 涉密项目的批量本地化通常要现场部署，遥测与外呼都要能整体关闭。
samples.reference: Classified batch localization normally runs on site, with telemetry and any outbound call closeable as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: For batch localization of confidential projects, on-site deployment is typically required, with telemetry and outbound calls both needing to be fully shut down.

samples.reference: In an offline delivery bundle, neither models nor vocabularies may rely on runtime downloads.
samples.hypothesis: The model and vocabulary cannot be downloaded at runtime when the offline integration package is delivered.

samples.reference: Privacy mode closes the upgrade path rather than sending source text to the cloud.
samples.hypothesis: Privacy mode disables the upgrade path, rather than sending the original text for cloud processing.

samples.reference: Logs must not carry source fragments; the user's material is itself sensitive.
samples.hypothesis: The log must not contain any original text fragments; the user's material itself is sensitive content.

samples.source: 导出文件时要检查元数据，轨道名与作者字段常会带上项目信息。
samples.reference: Check metadata on export: track titles and author fields often leak project names.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting files, check the metadata. The track name and author fields often contain project information.

samples.source: 审计记录只保留决策依据，不保留被翻译的正文。
samples.reference: Audit records keep the basis of a decision, never the translated text.
samples.hypothesis: Audit records only retain the decision rationale; the original text to be translated is not preserved.

samples.source: 本地化产物交给第三方前，要确认术语表里没有内部代号。

samples.hypothesis: Before delivering the localized product to a third party, confirm that the terminology list does not contain any internal code names.

samples.source: 禁用联网要能在配置层整体生效，而不是逐条网络调用点拦截。
samples.reference: Cutting network access has to work as one configuration switch, not per call site.
samples.hypothesis: To disable online connectivity at the configuration level, it must be applied globally rather than being blocked at individual network call points.

samples.source: 用户清空记忆库要连带清除派生的术语条目，否则残留仍会回显。

samples.hypothesis: The user's memory pool must be cleared, including all derived terminology entries, otherwise residual data will still appear.

samples.source: 现场部署的机器没有外网，安装介质要自带全部依赖与校验和。
samples.reference: A site machine has no outbound access, so the media must carry every dependency and its checksum.
samples.hypothesis: The on-site deployed machines do not have external network access. The installation media must include all dependencies and checksums.

samples.source: 版本回滚要能连带回滚术语表与记忆库结构，避免旧版读坏新格式。
